description.en: Area V1 (Brodmann area 17) along the banks of the calcarine sulcus on the medial occipital lobe, defined by its heavy myelination (stria of Gennari).
description.uz: Medial ensa bo'lagidagi kalkarin egat qirg'oqlari bo'ylab joylashgan V1 maydoni (Brodmann 17); kuchli mielinlashuvi (Gennari chizig'i) bilan ajralib turadi.

role.en: First cortical retinotopic map of the contralateral visual field: detects edges, spatial frequency, orientation and ocular dominance.
role.uz: Qarama-qarshi ko'rish maydonining birinchi po'stloq retinotopik xaritasi: qirralar, fazoviy chastota va yo'nalishni aniqlaydi.

clinical.en: Unilateral PCA lesion causes contralateral homonymous hemianopia (often with macular sparing); bilateral destruction causes cortical blindness.
clinical.uz: Bir tomonlama PCA zararlanishi qarama-qarshi gomonim gemianopsiya (ko'pincha makula saqlanishi bilan), ikki tomonlama zararlanishi kortikal ko'rlik beradi.

sources.title: Glasser et al. 2016, Nature — A multi-modal parcellation of human cerebral cortex

description.en: Area MST in the lateral temporo-occipital cortex immediately anterior/dorsal to motion area MT (V5) within the MT+ complex.
description.uz: Lateral chakka-ensa po'stlog'ida MT (V5) harakat maydonining bevosita oldi va ustida, MT+ kompleksi ichida joylashgan MST maydoni.

role.en: Processes large-field optic flow (expansion, rotation, translation) during self-motion and drives smooth-pursuit eye movements.
role.uz: O'z harakati davomida keng maydonli optik oqimni (kengayish, aylanish, siljish) tahlil qiladi va silliq kuzatuvchi ko'z harakatlarini boshqaradi.

clinical.en: Lesions impair smooth-pursuit eye movements toward the lesioned side and optic-flow heading perception.
clinical.uz: Zararlanishi o'choq tomonga silliq kuzatuvchi ko'z harakatlarini va optik oqim bo'yicha yo'nalishni idrok etishni buzadi.

sources.title: Glasser et al. 2016, Nature — A multi-modal parcellation of human cerebral cortex

description.en: Area V6 buried in the dorsal depth of the parieto-occipital sulcus on the medial hemisphere.
description.uz: Medial yarim sharda tepa-ensa egatining dorsal tubida joylashgan V6 ko'ruv maydoni.

role.en: Wide-field retinotopic representation without foveal magnification; distinguishes object motion from self-generated optic flow to guide reaching.
role.uz: Periferik ko'rish maydonini keng qamrab oladi; qo'l uzatishni boshqarish uchun jism harakatini o'z harakati optik oqimidan farqlaydi.

clinical.en: Dorsal parieto-occipital lesions involving V6/V6A contribute to optic ataxia.
clinical.uz: V6/V6A ni qamragan dorsal tepa-ensa zararlanishi optik ataksiyaga olib keladi.

sources.title: Glasser et al. 2016, Nature — A multi-modal parcellation of human cerebral cortex

description.en: Area V2 (Brodmann area 18) forming a concentric horseshoe band around V1 on the cuneus and lingual gyrus.
description.uz: Cuneus va tilsimon pushtada V1 atrofida taqasimon halqa hosil qiluvchi V2 maydoni (Brodmann 18).

role.en: Integrates V1 signals to extract illusory contours, binocular disparity (depth), figure–ground border ownership and colour.
role.uz: V1 signallarini birlashtirib, illyuzor konturlar, binokulyar chuqurlik, shakl-fon chegarasi va rangni ajratadi.

clinical.en: Upper bank (cuneus) lesions cause contralateral inferior quadrantanopia; lower bank (lingual) lesions cause superior quadrantanopia.
clinical.uz: Yuqori (cuneus) qismi zararlansa qarama-qarshi pastki kvadrantanopsiya, pastki (tilsimon) qismi zararlansa yuqori kvadrantanopsiya beradi.

sources.title: Glasser et al. 2016, Nature — A multi-modal parcellation of human cerebral cortex

description.en: Area V3 surrounding V2 dorsally on the cuneus/superior occipital cortex and ventrally on the lingual gyrus.
description.uz: Dorsal tomonda cuneus/yuqori ensa po'stlog'ida va ventral tomonda tilsimon pushtada V2 ni o'rab turuvchi V3 maydoni.

role.en: Processes dynamic form, global motion and stereoscopic depth, feeding both dorsal and ventral visual streams.
role.uz: Dinamik shakl, global harakat va stereoskopik chuqurlikni qayta ishlab, dorsal va ventral ko'ruv oqimlarini ta'minlaydi.

clinical.en: Damaged together with V1/V2 in posterior cerebral artery strokes, producing quadrantanopic or hemianopic field defects.
clinical.uz: Orqa miya arteriyasi insultlarida V1/V2 bilan birga zararlanib, kvadrantanopsiya yoki gemianopsiya beradi.

sources.title: Glasser et al. 2016, Nature — A multi-modal parcellation of human cerebral cortex

description.en: Area V4 on the ventral-lateral occipital surface anterior to V3 (spanning the lingual/fusiform transition and lateral occipital cortex).
description.uz: V3 dan oldinda, ventral-lateral ensa yuzasida (tilsimon va duksimon pushtalar o'tish joyida) joylashgan V4 ko'ruv maydoni.

role.en: Key intermediate stage of the ventral ("what") stream: colour constancy, texture, orientation curvature and feature-based visual attention.
role.uz: Ventral ('nima') oqimning muhim bosqichi: rang doimiyligi, tekstura, egri konturlar va belgiga yo'naltirilgan ko'ruv diqqati.

clinical.en: Ventral V4/V8 lesions cause cerebral achromatopsia (loss of colour vision in the contralateral hemifield or full field if bilateral).
clinical.uz: Ventral V4/V8 zararlanishi serebral axromatopsiyani (qarama-qarshi yarim maydonda yoki ikki tomonlama bo'lsa to'liq rang ko'rmaslikni) beradi.

sources.title: Glasser et al. 2016, Nature — A multi-modal parcellation of human cerebral cortex

description.en: Area V8 (ventral occipital area VO1) on the posterior fusiform and anterior lingual gyri immediately anterior to ventral V4.
description.uz: Orqa duksimon va oldingi tilsimon pushtalarda ventral V4 ning bevosita oldida joylashgan V8 (VO1) maydoni.

role.en: Retinotopic ventral colour- and surface-selective cortex with a strong foveal representation.
role.uz: Fovea vakilligi kuchli bo'lgan retinotopik ventral rang va yuza xususiyatlarini qayta ishlovchi po'stloq.

clinical.en: Lesions produce hemiachromatopsia or full cerebral achromatopsia when bilateral.
clinical.uz: Zararlanishi gemiaxromatopsiya, ikki tomonlama bo'lsa to'liq serebral axromatopsiya beradi.

sources.title: Glasser et al. 2016, Nature — A multi-modal parcellation of human cerebral cortex

description.en: Area 4 (primary motor cortex) occupying the anterior wall of the central sulcus, precentral gyrus crown and anterior paracentral lobule.
description.uz: Markaziy egatning oldingi devori, oldingi markaziy pushta cho'qqisi va oldingi paratsentral bo'lakchani egallagan 4-maydon (M1).

role.en: Heavily myelinated agranular cortex with giant Betz cells driving contralateral voluntary movement along the motor homunculus via the corticospinal tract.
role.uz: Gigant Betz hujayralariga ega kuchli mielinlangan agranulyar po'stloq; kortikospinal trakt orqali qarama-qarshi tana yarmi ixtiyoriy harakatini boshqaradi.

clinical.en: Lesions cause contralateral spastic paresis and loss of fractionated finger dexterity; seizures produce a Jacksonian motor march.
clinical.uz: Zararlanishi qarama-qarshi spastik parez va nozik barmoq harakatlari yo'qolishini beradi; tutqanoqlari Jekson harakat marshini chaqiradi.

sources.title: Glasser et al. 2016, Nature — A multi-modal parcellation of human cerebral cortex

description.en: Area 3b on the posterior wall of the central sulcus — the core primary somatosensory cortex.
description.uz: Markaziy egatning orqa devorida joylashgan 3b maydoni — birlamchi somatosensor po'stloqning asosiy o'zagi.

role.en: Receives dense cutaneous mechanoreceptor input from VPL and VPM of the thalamus, forming a sharp somatotopic map of touch on the opposite body.
role.uz: Talamusning VPL va VPM yadrolaridan teri mexanoretseptor kirishini zich qabul qilib, qarama-qarshi tana yarmi teginish sezgisining aniq xaritasini tuzadi.

clinical.en: Lesions cause contralateral loss of tactile detection, two-point discrimination and localization.
clinical.uz: Zararlanishi qarama-qarshi tomonda teginishni sezish, ikki nuqtani farqlash va joyini aniqlashni yo'qotadi.

sources.title: Glasser et al. 2016, Nature — A multi-modal parcellation of human cerebral cortex

description.en: Frontal eye field located at the junction of the precentral sulcus and the superior frontal sulcus.
description.uz: Oldingi markaziy egat bilan yuqori peshona egati tutashgan joyda joylashgan peshona ko'z maydoni (FEF).

role.en: Generates voluntary and memory-guided saccadic eye movements to the contralateral visual field and directs top-down spatial visual attention.
role.uz: Qarama-qarshi ko'rish maydoniga ixtiyoriy sakkadik ko'z harakatlarini hosil qiladi va fazoviy ko'ruv diqqatini yo'naltiradi.

clinical.en: Acute destructive lesions deviate both eyes toward the side of the lesion; epileptic discharge drives the eyes to the opposite side.
clinical.uz: O'tkir destruktiv zararlanishda ikkala ko'z o'choq tomonga, epileptik tutqanoqda esa qarama-qarshi tomonga og'adi.

sources.title: Glasser et al. 2016, Nature — A multi-modal parcellation of human cerebral cortex

description.en: Premotor eye field on the precentral gyrus ventral to the frontal eye field and dorsal to area 55b.
description.uz: Oldingi markaziy pushtada peshona ko'z maydonidan ventralda va 55b maydonidan dorsalda joylashgan premotor ko'z maydoni (PEF).

role.en: Coordinates visually triggered oculomotor orienting, blink reflexes and eye–head coordination inside the dorsal attention network.
role.uz: Dorsal diqqat tarmog'i tarkibida ko'ruv ta'sirida ko'z va boshni yo'naltirish hamda ko'z pirpiratishni muvofiqlashtiradi.

clinical.en: Lesions impair rapid visually guided saccades and oculomotor scanning.
clinical.uz: Zararlanishi ko'ruv mo'ljaliga tez sakkadalar qilishni va ko'z bilan ko'zdan kechirishni buzadi.

sources.title: Glasser et al. 2016, Nature — A multi-modal parcellation of human cerebral cortex

description.en: Lightly myelinated area 55b on the mid-precentral gyrus wedged between the frontal eye field/PEF dorsally and ventral premotor cortex (6v) ventrally.
description.uz: Oldingi markaziy pushtaning o'rta qismida dorsalda FEF/PEF bilan ventralda 6v orasida joylashgan kam mielinlangan 55b maydoni.

role.en: Language- and voice-selective premotor hub discovered in HCP-MMP1: links the dorsal larynx motor cortex with posterior language areas for speech fluency and prosody.
role.uz: HCP-MMP1 da kashf etilgan til va ovozga ixtisoslashgan premotor tugun: nutq ravonligi va ohang uchun hiqildoq harakat po'stlog'ini orqa til sohalari bilan bog'laydi.

clinical.en: Surgical resection or stroke of left area 55b causes severe apraxia of speech and loss of vocal pitch control.
clinical.uz: Chap 55b maydoni rezeksiyasi yoki insulti og'ir nutq apraksiyasi va ovoz ohangini boshqarish yo'qolishiga olib keladi.

sources.title: Glasser et al. 2016, Nature — A multi-modal parcellation of human cerebral cortex

description.en: Dorsal visual area V3A at the superior occipital / transverse occipital sulcus junction above dorsal V3.
description.uz: Dorsal V3 ustida, yuqori va ko'ndalang ensa egatlari tutashuvida joylashgan V3A dorsal ko'ruv maydoni.

role.en: Highly sensitive to coherent visual motion and stereoscopic depth across both upper and lower contralateral visual quadrants.
role.uz: Qarama-qarshi ko'rish maydonining yuqori va pastki kvadrantlarida uyg'un harakat va stereoskopik chuqurlikka yuqori sezgir.

clinical.en: Dorsal occipital lesions impair motion-based shape perception and depth judgements.
clinical.uz: Dorsal ensa zararlanishi harakatga asoslangan shakl va chuqurlikni idrok etishni buzadi.

sources.title: Glasser et al. 2016, Nature — A multi-modal parcellation of human cerebral cortex

description.en: Retrosplenial cortex (Brodmann areas 29 and 30) in the callosal sulcus and isthmus of the cingulate gyrus behind the splenium.
description.uz: Splenium ortida kallozal egat va belbog' pushtasi bo'ynida joylashgan retrosplenial po'stloq (Brodmann 29 va 30).

role.en: Translates between egocentric visual perspective and allocentric hippocampal spatial maps; supports episodic memory and scene navigation.
role.uz: Egotsentrik ko'ruv nuqtai nazari bilan allotsentrik gippokampal fazoviy xarita orasida tarjima qiladi; epizodik xotira va yo'l topishni ta'minlaydi.

clinical.en: Lesions cause retrosplenial amnesia and topographical disorientation; earliest hypometabolic site in Alzheimer disease.
clinical.uz: Zararlanishi retrosplenial amneziya va topografik dezoriyentatsiya beradi; Alzheimer kasalligida eng erta gipometabolizm joyi.

sources.title: Glasser et al. 2016, Nature — A multi-modal parcellation of human cerebral cortex

description.en: Area POS2 on the anterior-dorsal wall of the parieto-occipital sulcus above POS1.
description.uz: Tepa-ensa egatining oldingi-dorsal devorida, POS1 ustida joylashgan POS2 maydoni.

role.en: Multimodal medial parieto-occipital area integrating visual scene layout with dorsal default-mode and spatial-orientation networks.
role.uz: Ko'ruv manzarasi tuzilishini dorsal default-mode va fazoviy mo'ljal tarmoqlari bilan birlashtiruvchi medial tepa-ensa maydoni.

clinical.en: Medial parieto-occipital lesions contribute to spatial disorientation and impaired scene memory.
clinical.uz: Medial tepa-ensa zararlanishi fazoviy dezoriyentatsiya va manzara xotirasi buzilishiga olib keladi.

sources.title: Glasser et al. 2016, Nature — A multi-modal parcellation of human cerebral cortex

description.en: Area V7 (also called IPS0) at the junction of the transverse occipital sulcus and the posterior end of the intraparietal sulcus.
description.uz: Ko'ndalang ensa egati bilan tepa ichi egatining orqa uchi tutashgan joyda joylashgan V7 (IPS0) ko'ruv maydoni.

role.en: Entry point to the intraparietal retinotopic hierarchy: stereoscopic depth, spatial working memory and top-down visual attention.
role.uz: Tepa ichi retinotopik qatorining boshlanish nuqtasi: stereoskopik chuqurlik, fazoviy ishchi xotira va ko'ruv diqqati.

clinical.en: Lesions impair visuospatial working memory and spatial attention in the contralateral field.
clinical.uz: Zararlanishi qarama-qarshi maydonda ko'ruv-fazoviy ishchi xotira va diqqatni buzadi.

sources.title: Glasser et al. 2016, Nature — A multi-modal parcellation of human cerebral cortex

description.en: Area IPS1 in the posterior intraparietal sulcus immediately anterior/dorsal to V7 (IPS0).
description.uz: Orqa tepa ichi egatida V7 (IPS0) maydonining bevosita oldi va ustida joylashgan IPS1 maydoni.

role.en: Retinotopically organised dorsal-attention area maintaining spatial priority maps for saccades and visual working memory.
role.uz: Sakkadalar va ko'ruv ishchi xotirasi uchun fazoviy ustuvorlik xaritasini saqlovchi retinotopik dorsal diqqat maydoni.

clinical.en: Posterior IPS lesions cause contralateral visual extinction, simultagnosia or optic ataxia.
clinical.uz: Orqa IPS zararlanishi qarama-qarshi ko'ruv so'nishi (ekstinksiya), simultagnoziya yoki optik ataksiya beradi.

sources.title: Glasser et al. 2016, Nature — A multi-modal parcellation of human cerebral cortex

description.en: Fusiform face complex on the mid-fusiform gyrus (lateral bank of the mid-fusiform sulcus), heavily myelinated relative to adjacent temporal cortex.
description.uz: O'rta duksimon pushtada joylashgan duksimon yuz kompleksi (FFC); yondosh chakka po'stlog'iga nisbatan kuchliroq mielinlangan.

role.en: Core face-selective area (Kanwisher FFA1/FFA2) for holistic face perception and identity recognition on the right, and visual word/object form processing on the left.
role.uz: O'ngda yuzni yaxlit idrok etish va shaxsni tanishning asosiy markazi (FFA), chapda esa yozma so'z va narsa shaklini tanishda qatnashadi.

clinical.en: Right or bilateral lesions cause prosopagnosia (face blindness); left lesions cause pure alexia.
clinical.uz: O'ng yoki ikki tomonlama zararlanish prozopagnoziya (yuz ko'rligi), chap zararlanish sof aleksiya beradi.

sources.title: Glasser et al. 2016, Nature — A multi-modal parcellation of human cerebral cortex

description.en: Dorsal visual area V3B located lateral to V3A and ventral to V7 in the dorsal occipital cortex.
description.uz: Dorsal ensa po'stlog'ida V3A dan lateralda va V7 dan ventralda joylashgan V3B ko'ruv maydoni.

role.en: Contains the kinetic occipital (KO) region specialized for extracting motion-defined borders and 3D shape from motion and disparity.
role.uz: Harakat va binokulyar farq asosida 3D shakl hamda harakat chegaralarini ajratuvchi kinetik ensa (KO) sohasini o'z ichiga oladi.

clinical.en: Lesions impair perception of kinetic contours and 3D depth structure.
clinical.uz: Zararlanishi kinetik konturlar va 3D chuqurlik shaklini idrok etishni buzadi.

sources.title: Glasser et al. 2016, Nature — A multi-modal parcellation of human cerebral cortex

description.en: Area LO1 on the lateral occipital surface between dorsal V3 and lateral V4.
description.uz: Lateral ensa yuzasida dorsal V3 bilan lateral V4 orasida joylashgan LO1 maydoni.

role.en: Retinotopic extrastriate area extracting local orientation and boundary curvature for object-shape processing.
role.uz: Narsa shaklini qayta ishlash uchun mahalliy yo'nalish va chegara egriligini ajratib oluvchi retinotopik ekstrastriar maydon.

clinical.en: Lateral occipital lesions contribute to apperceptive visual form agnosia.
clinical.uz: Lateral ensa zararlanishi apperseptiv ko'ruv shakl agnoziyasiga hissa qo'shadi.

sources.title: Glasser et al. 2016, Nature — A multi-modal parcellation of human cerebral cortex

description.en: Area LO2 on the lateral occipital convexity immediately anterior to LO1.
description.uz: Lateral ensa qabariq yuzasida LO1 maydonining bevosita oldida joylashgan LO2 maydoni.

role.en: Shape-selective lateral occipital cortex representing 2D and 3D object geometry independent of low-level contrast.
role.uz: Past darajali kontrastdan qat'i nazar 2D va 3D narsa geometriyasini ifodalovchi shaklga sezgir lateral ensa po'stlog'i.

clinical.en: Damage impairs visual recognition of object shapes and line drawings (visual form agnosia).
clinical.uz: Zararlanishi narsa shakllari va chizma tasvirlarni ko'rib tanishni buzadi (ko'ruv shakl agnoziyasi).

sources.title: Glasser et al. 2016, Nature — A multi-modal parcellation of human cerebral cortex

description.en: Area PIT on the ventrolateral occipitotemporal surface anterior to V4/LO2 and lateral to the fusiform face complex.
description.uz: Ventrolateral ensa-chakka yuzasida V4/LO2 dan oldinda va duksimon yuz kompleksidan lateralda joylashgan PIT maydoni.

role.en: Ventral stream stage integrating colour, surface texture and local part features of faces and objects.
role.uz: Yuz va narsalarning rangi, yuza teksturasi hamda mahalliy qismlarini birlashtiruvchi ventral ko'ruv oqimi bosqichi.

clinical.en: Lesions contribute to prosopagnosia, object agnosia and colour-form integration deficits.
clinical.uz: Zararlanishi prozopagnoziya, narsa agnoziyasi va rang-shakl integratsiyasi buzilishiga olib keladi.

sources.title: Glasser et al. 2016, Nature — A multi-modal parcellation of human cerebral cortex

description.en: Area MT (V5) at the junction of the inferior temporal and lateral occipital sulci, distinguished by very dense cortical myelination.
description.uz: Pastki chakka va lateral ensa egatlari tutashuvida joylashgan, juda zich mielinlashuvi bilan ajralib turuvchi MT (V5) harakat maydoni.

role.en: Core motion-sensitive visual cortex: computes speed and direction of moving stimuli across the contralateral visual field.
role.uz: Harakatga sezgir asosiy ko'ruv po'stlog'i: qarama-qarshi ko'rish maydonidagi harakatlanuvchi jismlar tezligi va yo'nalishini hisoblaydi.

clinical.en: Bilateral lesions produce cerebral akinetopsia (motion blindness: moving objects appear as frozen snapshots).
clinical.uz: Ikki tomonlama zararlanishi serebral akinetopsiya (harakat ko'rligi: harakatdagi narsalar qotib qolgan kadrlar kabi ko'rinishi) beradi.

sources.title: Glasser et al. 2016, Nature — A multi-modal parcellation of human cerebral cortex

description.en: Primary auditory core (A1) on the medial two-thirds of Heschl’s transverse temporal gyrus inside the Sylvian fissure, heavily myelinated.
description.uz: Silviy egati ichida Geshl ko'ndalang chakka pushtasining medial ikki uchdan bir qismini egallagan, kuchli mielinlangan birlamchi eshituv o'zagi (A1).

role.en: Receives tonotopically organised input from the ventral medial geniculate body for elementary pitch, loudness and timing analysis.
role.uz: Ventral medial tizzasimon tanadan tonotopik tartiblangan kirishni qabul qilib, tovush balandligi, kuchi va vaqtini birlamchi tahlil qiladi.

clinical.en: Bilateral lesions cause cortical deafness; focal seizures produce simple auditory auras.
clinical.uz: Ikki tomonlama zararlanish kortikal karlik, fokal tutqanoqlari esa oddiy eshituv auralarini beradi.

sources.title: Glasser et al. 2016, Nature — A multi-modal parcellation of human cerebral cortex

description.en: Area PSL at the posterior-superior corner of the Sylvian fissure where the planum temporale meets the supramarginal gyrus (area Spt).
description.uz: Silviy egatining orqa-yuqori burchagida, planum temporale chekka usti pushtasiga tutashgan joydagi perisilviy til maydoni (PSL / Spt).

role.en: Auditory-motor interface for speech: converts heard phonological representations into articulatory motor plans for vocal repetition.
role.uz: Nutqning eshituv-harakat interfeysi: eshitilgan fonologik tasvirni takrorlab aytish uchun artikulyator harakat dasturiga aylantiradi.

clinical.en: Dominant lesions cause conduction aphasia with prominent phonemic paraphasias and impaired repetition.
clinical.uz: Dominant yarim shardagi zararlanishi fonemik parafaziyalar va takrorlash buzilishi bilan kechuvchi o'tkazuvchi afaziya beradi.

sources.title: Glasser et al. 2016, Nature — A multi-modal parcellation of human cerebral cortex

description.en: Area SFL on the medial/dorsal superior frontal gyrus just anterior to the supplementary motor area (pre-SMA language zone).
description.uz: Medial/dorsal yuqori peshona pushtasida qo'shimcha harakat sohasining (SMA) bevosita oldida joylashgan yuqori peshona til maydoni (SFL).

role.en: Connected via the frontal aslant tract (FAT) to Broca’s area: initiates spontaneous speech, verbal fluency and narrative sequencing.
role.uz: Peshona qiyshiq trakti (FAT) orqali Broka sohasi bilan bog'langan: spontan nutqni boshlash, so'z ravonligi va hikoya ketma-ketligini ta'minlaydi.

clinical.en: Dominant lesions or glioma resections here cause transcortical motor aphasia or transient post-operative speech mutism.
clinical.uz: Dominant yarim sharda zararlanishi yoki o'sma rezeksiyasi transkortikal motor afaziya yoki jarrohlikdan keyingi o'tkinchi nutq mutizmini beradi.

sources.title: Glasser et al. 2016, Nature — A multi-modal parcellation of human cerebral cortex

description.en: Area PCV on the anterior-central precuneus above the subparietal sulcus and anterior to visual parieto-occipital areas.
description.uz: Oldingi-markaziy precuneusda tepa osti egati ustida joylashgan precuneus ko'ruv maydoni (PCV).

role.en: Integrates visual motion and spatial memory with body movement for visuospatial imagery and navigation.
role.uz: Ko'ruv-fazoviy tasavvur va mo'ljal olish uchun ko'ruv harakati hamda fazoviy xotirani tana harakati bilan birlashtiradi.

clinical.en: Medial parietal lesions impair visuospatial mental rotation and navigation.
clinical.uz: Medial tepa zararlanishi ko'ruv-fazoviy tasavvur va yo'l topishni buzadi.

sources.title: Glasser et al. 2016, Nature — A multi-modal parcellation of human cerebral cortex

description.en: Area STV at the posterior superior temporal gyrus/sulcus junction just anterior to the temporo-parieto-occipital junction.
description.uz: Orqa yuqori chakka pushtasi va egati tutashuvida, chakka-tepa-ensa chorrahasining bevosita oldida joylashgan STV maydoni.

role.en: Processes biological motion (eye gaze, facial expression, hand actions) and integrates visual with auditory social signals.
role.uz: Biologik harakatni (nigoh, yuz ifodasi, qo'l harakati) qayta ishlaydi hamda ko'ruv va eshituv ijtimoiy signallarini birlashtiradi.

clinical.en: Lesions impair biological-motion perception and social gaze/intention decoding.
clinical.uz: Zararlanishi biologik harakatni va ijtimoiy nigoh/niyatni tushunishni buzadi.

sources.title: Glasser et al. 2016, Nature — A multi-modal parcellation of human cerebral cortex

description.en: Area 7Pm on the posterior-dorsal precuneus on the medial parietal surface just anterior to the parieto-occipital sulcus.
description.uz: Medial tepa yuzasida tepa-ensa egatining bevosita oldida, orqa-dorsal precuneusda joylashgan 7Pm maydoni.

role.en: Links dorsal visual stream representations with medial parietal spatial working memory and navigation circuits.
role.uz: Dorsal ko'ruv oqimi ma'lumotlarini medial tepa fazoviy ishchi xotira va navigatsiya zanjirlari bilan bog'laydi.

clinical.en: Lesions contribute to visuospatial disorientation and optic ataxia.
clinical.uz: Zararlanishi ko'ruv-fazoviy dezoriyentatsiya va optik ataksiyaga hissa qo'shadi.

sources.title: Glasser et al. 2016, Nature — A multi-modal parcellation of human cerebral cortex

description.en: Area 7m on the ventral-posterior precuneus between the parieto-occipital sulcus and the posterior cingulate cortex.
description.uz: Ventral-orqa precuneusda tepa-ensa egati bilan orqa belbog' po'stlog'i orasida joylashgan 7m maydoni.

role.en: Node of the posterior default-mode network connecting retrosplenial/hippocampal memory with medial parietal visuospatial processing.
role.uz: Retrosplenial/gippokampal xotirani medial tepa ko'ruv-fazoviy tahlili bilan bog'lovchi orqa default-mode tarmog'i tuguni.

clinical.en: Shows early metabolic decline in Alzheimer disease.
clinical.uz: Alzheimer kasalligida metabolizmi erta pasayadi.

sources.title: Glasser et al. 2016, Nature — A multi-modal parcellation of human cerebral cortex

description.en: Area POS1 in the ventral-anterior bank of the parieto-occipital sulcus adjacent to the retrosplenial complex and calcarine sulcus.
description.uz: Tepa-ensa egatining ventral-oldingi devorida, retrosplenial kompleks va kalkarin egat yonida joylashgan POS1 maydoni.

role.en: Scene- and place-selective medial parieto-occipital area (medial place area) linking visual scenes to spatial memory.
role.uz: Ko'ruv manzaralarini fazoviy xotira bilan bog'lovchi manzara va joyga sezgir medial tepa-ensa maydoni.

clinical.en: Lesions cause landmark/scene orientation deficits (topographical disorientation).
clinical.uz: Zararlanishi joy va mo'ljallarni tanish buzilishini (topografik dezoriyentatsiya) beradi.

sources.title: Glasser et al. 2016, Nature — A multi-modal parcellation of human cerebral cortex

description.en: Area 23d on the dorsal-anterior portion of the posterior cingulate gyrus above the posterior body of the corpus callosum.
description.uz: Qadoqsimon tananing orqa tanasi ustida, orqa belbog' pushtasining dorsal-oldingi qismida joylashgan 23d maydoni.

role.en: Transition hub between midcingulate cognitive control and posterior cingulate default-mode autobiographical memory networks.
role.uz: O'rta belbog' kognitiv nazorati bilan orqa belbog' default-mode avtobiografik xotira tarmoqlari orasidagi o'tish markazi.

clinical.en: Early site of amyloid plaque deposition and hypometabolism in Alzheimer disease.
clinical.uz: Alzheimer kasalligida amiloid to'planishi va gipometabolizmning erta joyi.

sources.title: Glasser et al. 2016, Nature — A multi-modal parcellation of human cerebral cortex

description.en: Area v23ab on the ventral bank of the posterior cingulate gyrus adjacent to the retrosplenial cortex above the splenium.
description.uz: Splenium ustida retrosplenial po'stloq yonida, orqa belbog' pushtasining ventral qismida joylashgan v23ab maydoni.

role.en: Core posterior default-mode node strongly coupled to the hippocampus and parahippocampal cortex for episodic memory retrieval.
role.uz: Epizodik xotirani chaqirish uchun gippokamp va parahippokampal po'stloq bilan kuchli bog'langan orqa default-mode tarmog'i o'zagi.

clinical.en: Severely affected early in Alzheimer disease; lesions contribute to retrosplenial/posterior cingulate amnesia.
clinical.uz: Alzheimer kasalligida erta zararlanadi; o'choqlari orqa belbog' amneziyasiga hissa qo'shadi.

sources.title: Glasser et al. 2016, Nature — A multi-modal parcellation of human cerebral cortex

description.en: Area d23ab on the crown of the posterior cingulate gyrus dorsal to v23ab and ventral to area 31.
description.uz: Orqa belbog' pushtasi cho'qqisida v23ab dan dorsalda va 31-maydondan ventralda joylashgan d23ab maydoni.

role.en: Central default-mode hub integrating self-referential thought, future prospection and episodic memory.
role.uz: O'zi haqida fikrlash, kelajakni tasavvur qilish va epizodik xotirani birlashtiruvchi markaziy default-mode tuguni.

clinical.en: Classic site of early FDG-PET hypometabolism in prodromal Alzheimer disease.
clinical.uz: Prodromal Alzheimer kasalligida FDG-PET gipometabolizmining klassik joyi.

sources.title: Glasser et al. 2016, Nature — A multi-modal parcellation of human cerebral cortex

description.en: Area 31pv on the posterior cingulate gyrus between d23ab ventrally and 31pd/31a dorsally.
description.uz: Orqa belbog' pushtasida ventralda d23ab bilan dorsalda 31pd/31a orasida joylashgan 31pv maydoni.

role.en: Posterior cingulate default-mode subdivision linking medial prefrontal and lateral parietal association cortices.
role.uz: Medial prefrontal va lateral tepa assotsiativ po'stloqlarini bog'lovchi orqa belbog' default-mode bo'linmasi.

clinical.en: Vulnerable to early metabolic and functional connectivity decline in Alzheimer disease.
clinical.uz: Alzheimer kasalligida metabolizmi va funksional aloqalari erta pasayadi.

sources.title: Glasser et al. 2016, Nature — A multi-modal parcellation of human cerebral cortex

description.en: Area 5m on the posterior paracentral lobule and anterior-dorsal precuneus behind the primary lower-limb somatosensory cortex.
description.uz: Orqa paratsentral bo'lakcha va oldingi-dorsal precuneusda, oyoq birlamchi somatosensor po'stlog'i ortida joylashgan 5m maydoni.

role.en: Medial somatosensory association cortex processing proprioception and posture of the lower limb and trunk.
role.uz: Oyoq va gavda propriosepsiyasi hamda holatini qayta ishlovchi medial somatosensor assotsiativ po'stloq.

clinical.en: Medial parietal lesions impair lower-limb position sense and postural control.
clinical.uz: Medial tepa zararlanishi oyoq holati sezgisini va tana muvozanatini buzadi.

sources.title: Glasser et al. 2016, Nature — A multi-modal parcellation of human cerebral cortex

description.en: Area 5mv in the cingulate sulcus marginal ramus immediately ventral to area 5m and dorsal to area 23c.
description.uz: Belbog' egatining chekka shoxida, 5m maydonidan ventralda va 23c maydonidan dorsalda joylashgan 5mv maydoni.

role.en: Integrates trunk/limb somatosensory feedback with caudal cingulate motor control.
role.uz: Gavda va oyoq-qo'l somatosensor qayta aloqasini kaudal belbog' harakat nazorati bilan birlashtiradi.

clinical.en: Lesions impair coordinated postural adjustments and sensorimotor integration.
clinical.uz: Zararlanishi muvofiqlashgan tana holati moslashuvini va sensomotor integratsiyani buzadi.

sources.title: Glasser et al. 2016, Nature — A multi-modal parcellation of human cerebral cortex

description.en: Area 23c in the posterior midcingulate sulcus beneath the paracentral lobule.
description.uz: Paratsentral bo'lakcha ostidagi orqa-o'rta belbog' egatida joylashgan 23c maydoni.

role.en: Caudal cingulate motor and somatosensory area projecting directly to the spinal cord and primary motor cortex for rapid defensive/orienting actions.
role.uz: Tezkor himoya va yo'nalish harakatlari uchun orqa miya hamda birlamchi harakat po'stlog'iga bevosita proyeksiya beruvchi kaudal belbog' harakat sohasi.

clinical.en: Lesions contribute to motor neglect and impaired voluntary movement initiation.
clinical.uz: Zararlanishi motor e'tiborsizlik va ixtiyoriy harakatni boshlash buzilishiga hissa qo'shadi.

sources.title: Glasser et al. 2016, Nature — A multi-modal parcellation of human cerebral cortex

description.en: Area 5L on the anterior crown of the superior parietal lobule immediately behind the postcentral gyrus (area 2).
description.uz: Yuqori tepa bo'lakchasining oldingi cho'qqisida, orqa markaziy pushta (2-maydon) ortida joylashgan 5L maydoni.

role.en: Higher-order somatosensory association cortex combining hand/arm proprioception with tactile shape for reaching and manipulation.
role.uz: Qo'l uzatish va ushlash uchun qo'l propriosepsiyasini taktil shakl bilan birlashtiruvchi yuqori tartibli somatosensor assotsiativ po'stloq.

clinical.en: Lesions cause contralateral tactile agnosia and tactile apraxia of the hand.
clinical.uz: Zararlanishi qarama-qarshi qo'lda taktil agnoziya va taktil apraksiya beradi.

sources.title: Glasser et al. 2016, Nature — A multi-modal parcellation of human cerebral cortex

description.en: Area 24dd on the upper bank of the midcingulate sulcus directly below the supplementary motor area and paracentral lobule.
description.uz: O'rta belbog' egatining yuqori qirg'og'ida, qo'shimcha harakat sohasi va paratsentral bo'lakcha ostida joylashgan 24dd maydoni.

role.en: Dorsal caudal cingulate motor area representing the lower limb and trunk in internally and feedback-guided movement.
role.uz: Ichki va qayta aloqa nazoratidagi harakatlarda oyoq hamda gavdani ifodalovchi dorsal kaudal belbog' harakat sohasi.

clinical.en: ACA strokes affecting 24d and SMA cause contralateral crural akinesia and abulia.
clinical.uz: 24d va SMA ni qamragan ACA insulti qarama-qarshi oyoq akineziyasi va abuliya beradi.

sources.title: Glasser et al. 2016, Nature — A multi-modal parcellation of human cerebral cortex

description.en: Area 7AL on the anterior-lateral superior parietal lobule behind area 5L and above the intraparietal sulcus.
description.uz: Yuqori tepa bo'lakchasining oldingi-lateral qismida, 5L maydoni ortida va tepa ichi egati ustida joylashgan 7AL maydoni.

role.en: Visuomotor and somatosensory integration for hand reaching and body-centred spatial coordinates.
role.uz: Qo'l uzatish va tana markazli fazoviy koordinatalar uchun vizuomotor hamda somatosensor integratsiya.

clinical.en: Lesions impair visually and proprioceptively guided reaching (optic ataxia).
clinical.uz: Zararlanishi ko'ruv va propriosepsiya nazoratidagi qo'l uzatishni buzadi (optik ataksiya).

sources.title: Glasser et al. 2016, Nature — A multi-modal parcellation of human cerebral cortex

description.en: Area SCEF on the medial frontal cortex spanning the upper bank of the cingulate sulcus and ventral pre-SMA/SMA.
description.uz: Medial peshona po'stlog'ida belbog' egati yuqori qirg'og'i va ventral pre-SMA/SMA bo'ylab joylashgan SCEF maydoni.

role.en: Medial oculomotor control hub: plans saccade sequences, monitors oculomotor conflict and inhibits reflexive saccades.
role.uz: Medial ko'z harakati markazi: sakkadalar ketma-ketligini rejalashtiradi, ko'z harakati ziddiyatini nazorat qiladi va reflektor sakkadalarni tormozlaydi.

clinical.en: Lesions impair anti-saccade performance and sequential memory-guided eye movements.
clinical.uz: Zararlanishi antisakkadalarni va xotiraga asoslangan ketma-ket ko'z harakatlarini buzadi.

sources.title: Glasser et al. 2016, Nature — A multi-modal parcellation of human cerebral cortex

description.en: Area 6ma on the dorsomedial superior frontal gyrus anterior to the supplementary motor area proper (6mp).
description.uz: Dorsomedial yuqori peshona pushtasida xususiy qo'shimcha harakat sohasidan (6mp) oldinda joylashgan 6ma (pre-SMA) maydoni.

role.en: Cognitive motor control: selecting action rules, switching motor plans, stopping ongoing actions and initiating speech.
role.uz: Harakatning kognitiv nazorati: harakat qoidalarini tanlash, rejani almashtirish, davom etayotgan harakatni to'xtatish va nutqni boshlash.

clinical.en: Lesions impair response inhibition and cause transient speech initiation deficits.
clinical.uz: Zararlanishi javobni tormozlashni buzadi va nutqni boshlashda o'tkinchi qiyinchilik beradi.

sources.title: Glasser et al. 2016, Nature — A multi-modal parcellation of human cerebral cortex

description.en: Cingulate motor subdivision on the lower bank of the posterior midcingulate sulcus below 24dd and posterior to p24'.
description.uz: Orqa-o'rta belbog' egatining pastki qirg'og'ida, 24dd ostida joylashgan belbog' harakat bo'linmasi (24dv).

role.en: Upper-limb and facial division of the caudal cingulate motor area, linking cognitive feedback to hand and vocal motor output.
role.uz: Kaudal belbog' harakat sohasining qo'l va yuz bo'limi; kognitiv qayta aloqani qo'l va ovoz harakati chiqishi bilan bog'laydi.

clinical.en: Medial frontal lesions here contribute to contralateral motor neglect and akinetic mutism.
clinical.uz: Bu yerdagi medial peshona zararlanishi qarama-qarshi motor e'tiborsizlik va akinetik mutizmga hissa qo'shadi.

sources.title: Glasser et al. 2016, Nature — A multi-modal parcellation of human cerebral cortex

description.en: Area 7Am on the anterodorsal precuneus and medial superior parietal lobule behind area 5m.
description.uz: Oldingi-dorsal precuneus va medial yuqori tepa bo'lakchasida, 5m maydoni ortida joylashgan 7Am maydoni.

role.en: Coordinates visuospatial attention, egocentric spatial reference frames and visually guided limb movements.
role.uz: Ko'ruv-fazoviy diqqat, egotsentrik fazoviy sanoq tizimi va ko'ruv nazoratidagi oyoq-qo'l harakatlarini muvofiqlashtiradi.

clinical.en: Lesions cause optic ataxia and visuospatial disorientation.
clinical.uz: Zararlanishi optik ataksiya va ko'ruv-fazoviy dezoriyentatsiya beradi.

sources.title: Glasser et al. 2016, Nature — A multi-modal parcellation of human cerebral cortex

description.en: Area 7PL on the posterior-lateral crown of the superior parietal lobule above the intraparietal sulcus.
description.uz: Yuqori tepa bo'lakchasining orqa-lateral cho'qqisida, tepa ichi egati ustida joylashgan 7PL maydoni.

role.en: Dorsal visuospatial attention and visuomotor transformation for reaching into peripheral space.
role.uz: Periferik fazoga qo'l uzatish uchun dorsal ko'ruv-fazoviy diqqat va vizuomotor transformatsiya.

clinical.en: Lesions cause contralateral optic ataxia and spatial attention deficits.
clinical.uz: Zararlanishi qarama-qarshi tomonda optik ataksiya va fazoviy diqqat nuqsonini beradi.

sources.title: Glasser et al. 2016, Nature — A multi-modal parcellation of human cerebral cortex

description.en: Area 7PC at the anterior-lateral corner of the superior parietal lobule behind the postcentral sulcus and above AIP.
description.uz: Yuqori tepa bo'lakchasining oldingi-lateral burchagida, orqa markaziy egat ortida va AIP ustida joylashgan 7PC maydoni.

role.en: Somatosensory-visual convergence zone guiding hand preshaping and reach trajectories toward targets.
role.uz: Nishonga qo'l uzatish yo'nalishi va panjani moslashtirishni boshqaruvchi somatosensor-ko'ruv konvergensiya zonasi.

clinical.en: Lesions impair hand transport and tactile-visual guidance during reaching.
clinical.uz: Zararlanishi qo'l uzatishda panjani ko'ruv va sezgi asosida yo'naltirishni buzadi.

sources.title: Glasser et al. 2016, Nature — A multi-modal parcellation of human cerebral cortex

description.en: Area LIPv on the lateral/upper bank of the mid-intraparietal sulcus ventral to LIPd.
description.uz: O'rta tepa ichi egatining yuqori-lateral devorida LIPd ostida joylashgan LIPv maydoni.

role.en: Retinotopic priority map for saccadic eye movements and covert shifts of visual spatial attention.
role.uz: Sakkadik ko'z harakatlari va fazoviy ko'ruv diqqatini ko'chirish uchun retinotopik ustuvorlik xaritasi.

clinical.en: Right LIP lesions disrupt the dorsal attention network and contribute to contralateral visual neglect and extinction.
clinical.uz: O'ng LIP zararlanishi dorsal diqqat tarmog'ini buzib, qarama-qarshi ko'ruv e'tiborsizligi (neglect) va so'nishini beradi.

sources.title: Glasser et al. 2016, Nature — A multi-modal parcellation of human cerebral cortex

description.en: Area VIP in the fundus of the intraparietal sulcus surrounded by LIP, MIP and area 7.
description.uz: Tepa ichi egati tubida LIP, MIP va 7-maydonlar orasida joylashgan VIP kompleksi.

role.en: Multisensory (visual, tactile, vestibular, auditory) map of peripersonal space around the head and upper body for collision avoidance.
role.uz: To'qnashuvdan himoyalanish uchun bosh va gavda atrofidagi yaqin fazoning ko'p sezgili (ko'ruv, taktil, vestibulyar, eshituv) xaritasi.

clinical.en: Lesions impair peripersonal space representation and defensive visuomotor reactions.
clinical.uz: Zararlanishi tana atrofidagi yaqin fazoni idrok etishni va himoya vizuomotor reaksiyalarini buzadi.

sources.title: Glasser et al. 2016, Nature — A multi-modal parcellation of human cerebral cortex

description.en: Area MIP on the medial/posterior bank of the intraparietal sulcus (part of the parietal reach region).
description.uz: Tepa ichi egatining medial-orqa devorida joylashgan MIP maydoni (tepa qo'l uzatish sohasining qismi).

role.en: Transforms visual target coordinates into arm-reaching motor commands in concert with dorsal premotor cortex (PMd).
role.uz: Dorsal premotor po'stloq (PMd) bilan birgalikda ko'ruv nishoni koordinatalarini qo'l uzatish harakat buyruqlariga aylantiradi.

clinical.en: Lesions cause classic optic ataxia (misreaching for visual targets despite intact motor strength and primary vision).
clinical.uz: Zararlanishi klassik optik ataksiyani (harakat kuchi va ko'rish saqlangan holda nishonga noaniq qo'l uzatishni) beradi.

sources.title: Glasser et al. 2016, Nature — A multi-modal parcellation of human cerebral cortex

description.en: Brodmann area 1 running along the crown of the postcentral gyrus between area 3b anteriorly and area 2 posteriorly.
description.uz: Orqa markaziy pushta cho'qqisi bo'ylab oldinda 3b va orqada 2-maydon orasida joylashgan Brodmann 1-maydoni.

role.en: Processes cutaneous texture, slip and multi-digit tactile features relayed from area 3b.
role.uz: 3b maydonidan uzatilgan teri teksturasi, sirpanish va bir necha barmoq taktil belgilarini qayta ishlaydi.

clinical.en: Lesions impair fine texture discrimination and two-point tactile acuity on the opposite body.
clinical.uz: Zararlanishi qarama-qarshi tomonda nozik teksturani va ikki nuqtani farqlashni buzadi.

sources.title: Glasser et al. 2016, Nature — A multi-modal parcellation of human cerebral cortex

description.en: Brodmann area 2 on the posterior wall of the postcentral gyrus and anterior bank of the postcentral sulcus.
description.uz: Orqa markaziy pushtaning orqa devori va orqa markaziy egatning oldingi qirg'og'ida joylashgan Brodmann 2-maydoni.

role.en: Combines cutaneous touch from area 3b/1 with deep joint and muscle proprioception from area 3a to perceive object size and 3D shape (stereognosis).
role.uz: Narsaning o'lchami va 3D shaklini paypaslab bilish (stereognoz) uchun teri sezgisini (3b/1) chuqur bo'g'im-mushak propriosepsiyasi (3a) bilan birlashtiradi.

clinical.en: Lesions cause contralateral astereognosis (inability to identify objects by touch alone).
clinical.uz: Zararlanishi qarama-qarshi qo'lda astereognoz (narsani faqat paypaslab taniy olmaslik) beradi.

sources.title: Glasser et al. 2016, Nature — A multi-modal parcellation of human cerebral cortex

description.en: Brodmann area 3a in the deep floor (fundus) of the central sulcus between primary motor area 4 and cutaneous area 3b.
description.uz: Markaziy egatning eng chuqur tubida birlamchi harakat (4-maydon) va teri sezgisi (3b) maydonlari orasida joylashgan 3a maydoni.

role.en: Receives muscle-spindle and deep joint proprioceptive input from the thalamus and links directly with primary motor cortex for kinesthesia.
role.uz: Talamusdan mushak duklari va bo'g'im proprioseptiv kirishini qabul qiladi hamda harakat sezgisi (kinesteziya) uchun M1 bilan bevosita bog'lanadi.

clinical.en: Lesions cause loss of conscious joint position and movement sense (kinesthetic ataxia) on the opposite side.
clinical.uz: Zararlanishi qarama-qarshi tomonda bo'g'im holati va harakat sezgisining yo'qolishini (kinestetik ataksiya) beradi.

sources.title: Glasser et al. 2016, Nature — A multi-modal parcellation of human cerebral cortex

description.en: Area 6d on the dorsal precentral gyrus immediately anterior to the upper-limb and trunk primary motor cortex.
description.uz: Dorsal oldingi markaziy pushtada qo'l va gavda birlamchi harakat po'stlog'ining bevosita oldida joylashgan 6d maydoni.

role.en: Caudal dorsal premotor cortex (PMd): prepares and guides reaching and proximal limb movements using visual and somatosensory cues.
role.uz: Kaudal dorsal premotor po'stloq (PMd): ko'ruv va somatosensor mo'ljallar asosida qo'l uzatish va proksimal harakatlarni tayyorlaydi.

clinical.en: Lesions cause limb-kinetic apraxia and difficulty coordinating proximal arm and shoulder movements.
clinical.uz: Zararlanishi oyoq-qo'l kinetik apraksiyasi va yelka-qo'l harakatlarini muvofiqlashtirish qiyinligini beradi.

sources.title: Glasser et al. 2016, Nature — A multi-modal parcellation of human cerebral cortex

description.en: Area 6mp on the posterior medial superior frontal gyrus just in front of the paracentral lobule — the supplementary motor area proper.
description.uz: Orqa medial yuqori peshona pushtasida paratsentral bo'lakcha oldida joylashgan 6mp maydoni — xususiy qo'shimcha harakat sohasi (SMA).

role.en: Initiates internally generated movement sequences, bimanual coordination and postural stabilization.
role.uz: Ichki rejalashtirilgan harakat ketma-ketliklarini boshlash, ikki qo'l muvofiqligi va tana muvozanatini ta'minlaydi.

clinical.en: Surgical resection or ACA infarction produces the SMA syndrome (contralateral akinesia and mutism that typically recovers over weeks).
clinical.uz: Jarrohlik rezeksiyasi yoki ACA infarkti SMA sindromini (haftalar ichida tiklanuvchi qarama-qarshi akineziya va mutizm) keltirib chiqaradi.

sources.title: Glasser et al. 2016, Nature — A multi-modal parcellation of human cerebral cortex

description.en: Area 6v on the lower precentral gyrus anterior to the face and hand representations of primary motor cortex.
description.uz: Pastki oldingi markaziy pushtada M1 ning yuz va qo'l vakilligi oldida joylashgan 6v (ventral premotor) maydoni.

role.en: Controls hand grasping, orofacial/articulatory motor coordination and mirror-neuron action recognition in concert with area AIP and PF.
role.uz: AIP va PF maydonlari bilan birgalikda qo'l bilan ushlash, yuz-og'iz artikulyatsiyasi va ko'zgu neyronlari orqali harakatni tushunishni boshqaradi.

clinical.en: Lesions cause apraxia of speech, buccofacial apraxia and impaired hand preshaping for grasping.
clinical.uz: Zararlanishi nutq apraksiyasi, yuz-og'iz apraksiyasi va narsani ushlashda panjani moslashtirish buzilishini beradi.

sources.title: Glasser et al. 2016, Nature — A multi-modal parcellation of human cerebral cortex

description.en: Area p24 in the pregenual/dorsal anterior cingulate gyrus curving over the anterior corpus callosum.
description.uz: Oldingi qadoqsimon tana ustidan egilib o'tuvchi tizza oldi/dorsal oldingi belbog' pushtasidagi p24 maydoni.

role.en: Integrates emotional and visceral signals with cognitive control and pain modulation.
role.uz: Emotsional va visseral signallarni kognitiv nazorat hamda og'riq modulyatsiyasi bilan birlashtiradi.

clinical.en: Involved in affective pain processing, apathy syndromes and mood disorders.
clinical.uz: Og'riqning affektiv idroki, apatiya sindromlari va kayfiyat buzilishlarida ishtirok etadi.

sources.title: Glasser et al. 2016, Nature — A multi-modal parcellation of human cerebral cortex

description.en: Area 33 prime forming a narrow ribbon deep in the callosal sulcus directly abutting the dorsal surface of the corpus callosum.
description.uz: Kallozal egat tubida qadoqsimon tananing ustki yuzasiga bevosita tegib yotuvchi tor tasma shaklidagi 33' maydoni.

role.en: Thin periallocortical transition belt between the corpus callosum indusium griseum and midcingulate area 24.
role.uz: Qadoqsimon tana ustidagi indusium griseum bilan o'rta belbog' 24-maydoni orasidagi periallokortikal o'tish tasmasi.

clinical.en: Damaged along with the pericallosal artery in distal ACA infarcts or callosal gliomas.
clinical.uz: Distal ACA infarktlari yoki qadoqsimon tana gliomalarida perikallozal arteriya bilan birga zararlanadi.

sources.title: Glasser et al. 2016, Nature — A multi-modal parcellation of human cerebral cortex

description.en: Area a24 prime on the midcingulate gyrus above the anterior body of the corpus callosum.
description.uz: Qadoqsimon tana tanasining oldingi qismi ustidagi o'rta belbog' pushtasida joylashgan a24' maydoni.

role.en: Anterior midcingulate cognitive-control and salience hub monitoring response conflict, pain and reward effort.
role.uz: Javob ziddiyati, og'riq va harakat kuchini baholovchi oldingi-o'rta belbog' kognitiv nazorat va salience markazi.

clinical.en: Target region of stereotactic anterior cingulotomy for intractable pain and OCD; bilateral damage causes akinetic mutism.
clinical.uz: Rezistent og'riq va OKBda stereotaktik oldingi singulotomiya nishoni; ikki tomonlama zararlanishi akinetik mutizm beradi.

sources.title: Glasser et al. 2016, Nature — A multi-modal parcellation of human cerebral cortex

description.en: Area p32 prime in the dorsal bank of the midcingulate sulcus above area a24' and ventral to SCEF.
description.uz: O'rta belbog' egatining dorsal qirg'og'ida, a24' ustida va SCEF ostida joylashgan p32' maydoni.

role.en: Cognitive control network node supporting error detection, decision uncertainty and task-set maintenance.
role.uz: Xatoni aniqlash, noaniqlikda qaror qabul qilish va vazifa holatini saqlashni ta'minlovchi kognitiv nazorat tuguni.

clinical.en: Lesions impair conflict resolution and executive initiation.
clinical.uz: Zararlanishi ziddiyatni hal qilish va ijrochi tashabbusni buzadi.

sources.title: Glasser et al. 2016, Nature — A multi-modal parcellation of human cerebral cortex

description.en: Area a24 on the rostral/pregenual anterior cingulate gyrus immediately in front of the genu of the corpus callosum.
description.uz: Qadoqsimon tana tizzasining bevosita oldidagi rostral oldingi belbog' pushtasida joylashgan a24 maydoni.

role.en: Core medial default-mode and affective cingulate node: emotional valuation, social cognition and autonomic regulation.
role.uz: Medial default-mode va affektiv belbog' tuguni: emotsional baholash, ijtimoiy kognitsiya va vegetativ boshqaruv.

clinical.en: Shows altered activity and connectivity to the dorsolateral prefrontal cortex in major depressive disorder.
clinical.uz: Og'ir depressiyada faolligi va dorsolateral prefrontal po'stloq bilan aloqasi o'zgaradi.

sources.title: Glasser et al. 2016, Nature — A multi-modal parcellation of human cerebral cortex

description.en: Area d32 on the medial prefrontal surface dorsal to the anterior cingulate sulcus and anterior to 8BM.
description.uz: Medial prefrontal yuzada oldingi belbog' egatidan dorsalda va 8BM maydonidan oldinda joylashgan d32 maydoni.

role.en: Medial prefrontal cognitive-control and theory-of-mind area evaluating social intentions and decision outcomes.
role.uz: Ijtimoiy niyatlar va qaror natijalarini baholovchi medial prefrontal kognitiv nazorat hamda mentalizatsiya maydoni.

clinical.en: Medial frontal lesions cause apathy, reduced spontaneous speech and impaired social mentalizing.
clinical.uz: Medial peshona zararlanishi apatiya, spontan nutq kamayishi va ijtimoiy tushunish buzilishini beradi.

sources.title: Glasser et al. 2016, Nature — A multi-modal parcellation of human cerebral cortex

description.en: Area 8BM on the dorsomedial superior frontal gyrus anterior to pre-SMA/SCEF and dorsal to d32.
description.uz: Dorsomedial yuqori peshona pushtasida pre-SMA/SCEF dan oldinda va d32 dan dorsalda joylashgan 8BM maydoni.

role.en: Part of the multiple-demand cognitive control network: rule retrieval, working memory and decision monitoring.
role.uz: Ko'p talabli (multiple-demand) kognitiv nazorat tarmog'i qismi: qoidalarni eslash, ishchi xotira va qaror monitoringi.

clinical.en: Lesions impair complex executive rule switching and cognitive effort allocation.
clinical.uz: Zararlanishi murakkab ijrochi qoidalarni almashtirish va kognitiv diqqatni taqsimlashni buzadi.

sources.title: Glasser et al. 2016, Nature — A multi-modal parcellation of human cerebral cortex

description.en: Area p32 on the rostral medial prefrontal surface anterior to pregenual area a24 and caudal to 10r.
description.uz: Rostral medial prefrontal yuzada tizza oldi a24 maydonidan oldinda va 10r dan orqada joylashgan p32 maydoni.

role.en: Affective and self-referential medial prefrontal hub of the default-mode network, regulating optimism, valuation and emotion.
role.uz: Default-mode tarmog'ining o'zi haqida fikrlash, qiymat berish va emotsiyani boshqaruvchi medial prefrontal markazi.

clinical.en: Lesions cause emotional blunting and impaired value-based choice; dysfunctional in mood and anxiety disorders.
clinical.uz: Zararlanishi emotsional to'mtoqlik va qiymatga asoslangan tanlov buzilishini beradi; depressiya va xavotirda disfunksiyaga uchraydi.

sources.title: Glasser et al. 2016, Nature — A multi-modal parcellation of human cerebral cortex

description.en: Area 10r on the rostral ventromedial prefrontal surface anterior to p32 and dorsal to 10v.
description.uz: Rostral ventromedial prefrontal yuzada p32 dan oldinda va 10v dan dorsalda joylashgan 10r maydoni.

role.en: Anterior default-mode node integrating episodic memory, future imagination and personal value.
role.uz: Epizodik xotira, kelajakni tasavvur qilish va shaxsiy ahamiyatni birlashtiruvchi oldingi default-mode tuguni.

clinical.en: Ventromedial frontopolar lesions impair personal decision making and prospective memory.
clinical.uz: Ventromedial peshona qutbi zararlanishi shaxsiy qaror qabul qilish va kelajakka mo'ljallangan xotirani buzadi.

sources.title: Glasser et al. 2016, Nature — A multi-modal parcellation of human cerebral cortex

description.en: Area 47m on the lateral orbital surface medial to 47l and lateral to area 11l/13l.
description.uz: Lateral orbital yuzada 47l dan medialda va 11l/13l maydonlaridan lateralda joylashgan 47m maydoni.

role.en: Orbitofrontal valuation area linking sensory/semantic representations with reward and non-reward outcomes.
role.uz: Sezgi va semantik ma'lumotlarni mukofot yoki jazoga bog'lovchi orbitofrontal baholash maydoni.

clinical.en: Lesions impair reversal learning and adaptive behavioural switching.
clinical.uz: Zararlanishi reversiv o'rganish va o'zgaruvchan sharoitga moslashishni buzadi.

sources.title: Glasser et al. 2016, Nature — A multi-modal parcellation of human cerebral cortex

description.en: Area 8Av on the posterior middle frontal gyrus ventral to 8Ad and anterior to area 8C.
description.uz: Orqa o'rta peshona pushtasida 8Ad dan ventralda va 8C maydonidan oldinda joylashgan 8Av maydoni.

role.en: Dorsolateral prefrontal node coupling visual/spatial attention with working memory and cognitive control.
role.uz: Ko'ruv-fazoviy diqqatni ishchi xotira va kognitiv nazorat bilan bog'lovchi dorsolateral prefrontal tugun.

clinical.en: Lesions cause executive working-memory and attentional filtering deficits.
clinical.uz: Zararlanishi ijrochi ishchi xotira va diqqatni filtrlash nuqsonini beradi.

sources.title: Glasser et al. 2016, Nature — A multi-modal parcellation of human cerebral cortex

description.en: Area 8Ad on the posterior superior frontal sulcus and dorsal middle frontal gyrus anterior to the frontal eye field.
description.uz: Orqa yuqori peshona egati va dorsal o'rta peshona pushtasida peshona ko'z maydonidan oldinda joylashgan 8Ad maydoni.

role.en: Spatial working memory and executive oculomotor planning.
role.uz: Fazoviy ishchi xotira va ko'z harakatlarini ijrochi rejalashtirish.

clinical.en: Lesions impair spatial working memory and voluntary gaze control.
clinical.uz: Zararlanishi fazoviy ishchi xotira va ixtiyoriy nigoh nazoratini buzadi.

sources.title: Glasser et al. 2016, Nature — A multi-modal parcellation of human cerebral cortex

description.en: Area 9m on the anterior dorsomedial surface of the superior frontal gyrus above d32 and 10d.
description.uz: Yuqori peshona pushtasining oldingi dorsomedial yuzasida d32 va 10d ustida joylashgan 9m maydoni.

role.en: Core social-cognition (theory of mind) and default-mode area for reasoning about others’ beliefs, emotions and intentions.
role.uz: Boshqalarning fikri, hissiyoti va niyatlari haqida mulohaza yurituvchi ijtimoiy kognitsiya (mentalizatsiya) va default-mode maydoni.

clinical.en: Lesions impair social inference, empathy and autobiographical reflection.
clinical.uz: Zararlanishi ijtimoiy xulosa chiqarish, empatiya va avtobiografik mulohazani buzadi.

sources.title: Glasser et al. 2016, Nature — A multi-modal parcellation of human cerebral cortex

description.en: Area 8BL on the crown of the superior frontal gyrus lateral to 8BM and medial to 8Ad.
description.uz: Yuqori peshona pushtasi cho'qqisida 8BM dan lateralda va 8Ad dan medialda joylashgan 8BL maydoni.

role.en: Bridges the default-mode/social network with executive prefrontal control during internally guided cognition.
role.uz: Ichki yo'nalgan tafakkur davomida default-mode/ijtimoiy tarmoqni ijrochi prefrontal nazorat bilan bog'laydi.

clinical.en: Lesions contribute to dysexecutive symptoms and reduced cognitive initiative.
clinical.uz: Zararlanishi dizeksekutiv belgilar va kognitiv tashabbus pasayishiga olib keladi.

sources.title: Glasser et al. 2016, Nature — A multi-modal parcellation of human cerebral cortex

description.en: Area 9p on the dorsal superior frontal gyrus anterior to 8BL/8Ad and posterior to 9a.
description.uz: Dorsal yuqori peshona pushtasida 8BL/8Ad dan oldinda va 9a dan orqada joylashgan 9p maydoni.

role.en: Supports abstract cognitive reasoning, narrative comprehension and executive goal maintenance.
role.uz: Mavhum kognitiv mulohaza, matn mazmunini tushunish va maqsadni saqlashni ta'minlaydi.

clinical.en: Lesions impair high-level planning and executive organization.
clinical.uz: Zararlanishi yuqori darajali rejalashtirish va ijrochi tartibni buzadi.

sources.title: Glasser et al. 2016, Nature — A multi-modal parcellation of human cerebral cortex

description.en: Area 10d on the dorsal-medial aspect of the frontal pole below 9m and above 10r/10pp.
description.uz: Peshona qutbining dorsal-medial qismida 9m ostida va 10r/10pp ustida joylashgan 10d maydoni.

role.en: Frontopolar hub linking default-mode prospection with executive multitasking and long-term goal tracking.
role.uz: Kelajakni tasavvur qilishni ijrochi ko'p vazifalilik va uzoq muddatli maqsad nazorati bilan bog'lovchi qutb markazi.

clinical.en: Frontopolar contusions or resections impair real-life multitasking and prospective memory.
clinical.uz: Peshona qutbi kontuziyasi yoki rezeksiyasi kundalik ko'p vazifalilik va kelajakka mo'ljallangan xotirani buzadi.

sources.title: Glasser et al. 2016, Nature — A multi-modal parcellation of human cerebral cortex

description.en: Area 8C in the posterior middle frontal gyrus/inferior precentral junction between 8Av and IFJp/PEF.
description.uz: Orqa o'rta peshona pushtasida 8Av bilan IFJp/PEF orasida joylashgan 8C maydoni.

role.en: Multiple-demand cognitive-control node integrating working memory with oculomotor and manual action selection.
role.uz: Ishchi xotirani ko'z va qo'l harakati tanlovi bilan birlashtiruvchi kognitiv nazorat tuguni.

clinical.en: Lesions impair attentional control and working-memory updating.
clinical.uz: Zararlanishi diqqat nazorati va ishchi xotirani yangilashni buzadi.

sources.title: Glasser et al. 2016, Nature — A multi-modal parcellation of human cerebral cortex

description.en: Brodmann area 44 on the pars opercularis of the inferior frontal gyrus in front of the ventral precentral sulcus.
description.uz: Pastki peshona pushtasining qopqoq qismida (pars opercularis), ventral oldingi markaziy egat oldida joylashgan 44-maydon.

role.en: Posterior core of Broca’s area in the left hemisphere (syntactic structure building and phonological-motor speech programming); response inhibition on the right.
role.uz: Chap yarim sharda Broka sohasining orqa o'zagi (sintaktik qurilish va nutqning fonologik-harakat dasturi); o'ngda harakatni tormozlash.

clinical.en: Left lesions cause non-fluent, agrammatic Broca’s aphasia; critical eloquent zone spared during awake glioma surgery.
clinical.uz: Chap zararlanishi noravon, agrammatik Broka afaziyasini beradi; uyg'oq glioma jarrohligida saqlanishi shart bo'lgan nutq zonasi.

sources.title: Glasser et al. 2016, Nature — A multi-modal parcellation of human cerebral cortex

description.en: Brodmann area 45 on the pars triangularis of the inferior frontal gyrus between the horizontal and ascending rami of the lateral sulcus.
description.uz: Pastki peshona pushtasining uchburchak qismida (pars triangularis), lateral egatning gorizontal va ko'tariluvchi shoxlari orasidagi 45-maydon.

role.en: Anterior core of Broca’s area: controlled semantic/lexical retrieval and sentence-level language comprehension.
role.uz: Broka sohasining oldingi o'zagi: boshqariladigan leksik-semantik chaqirish va gap darajasida tilni tushunish.

clinical.en: Combined damage with area 44 produces chronic Broca’s aphasia.
clinical.uz: 44-maydon bilan birgalikda zararlanishi surunkali Broka afaziyasini keltirib chiqaradi.

sources.title: Glasser et al. 2016, Nature — A multi-modal parcellation of human cerebral cortex

description.en: Area 47l on the lateral orbital part of the inferior frontal gyrus ventral to area 45.
description.uz: Pastki peshona pushtasining lateral orbital qismida, 45-maydondan ventralda joylashgan 47l maydoni.

role.en: Ventral semantic language hub connected via the IFOF and uncinate fasciculus to temporal semantic cortex.
role.uz: IFOF va ilmoqsimon tutam orqali chakka semantik po'stlog'i bilan bog'langan ventral semantik til markazi.

clinical.en: Dominant lesions impair semantic word selection and comprehension of figurative or ambiguous language.
clinical.uz: Dominant yarim shardagi zararlanishi so'zlarni semantik tanlash va ko'chma ma'nolarni tushunishni buzadi.

sources.title: Glasser et al. 2016, Nature — A multi-modal parcellation of human cerebral cortex

description.en: Area a47r at the rostral-ventral corner of the lateral prefrontal cortex between the frontal pole and pars orbitalis.
description.uz: Lateral prefrontal po'stloqning rostral-ventral burchagida, peshona qutbi bilan pars orbitalis orasida joylashgan a47r maydoni.

role.en: Ventrolateral prefrontal cognitive control: relational reasoning, rule abstraction and semantic working memory.
role.uz: Ventrolateral prefrontal kognitiv nazorat: munosabatlar ustida mulohaza, qoidalarni umumlashtirish va semantik ishchi xotira.

clinical.en: Lesions impair flexible rule application and controlled memory retrieval.
clinical.uz: Zararlanishi qoidalarni moslashuvchan qo'llash va xotiradan tanlab eslashni buzadi.

sources.title: Glasser et al. 2016, Nature — A multi-modal parcellation of human cerebral cortex

description.en: Area 6r in the inferior precentral sulcus and posterior bank of the pars opercularis between area 44 and 6v.
description.uz: Pastki oldingi markaziy egat va pars opercularis orqa qirg'og'ida, 44 va 6v maydonlari orasida joylashgan 6r maydoni.

role.en: Auditory-motor and articulatory premotor interface coordinating speech production and orofacial praxis.
role.uz: Nutq hosil qilish va yuz-og'iz praksisini muvofiqlashtiruvchi eshituv-harakat hamda artikulyator premotor interfeys.

clinical.en: Dominant lesions cause apraxia of speech and non-fluent articulatory breakdown.
clinical.uz: Dominant zararlanishi nutq apraksiyasi va artikulyatsiya buzilishini beradi.

sources.title: Glasser et al. 2016, Nature — A multi-modal parcellation of human cerebral cortex

description.en: Area IFJa in the posterior inferior frontal sulcus immediately anterior to IFJp and dorsal to area 44.
description.uz: Orqa pastki peshona egatida IFJp ning bevosita oldida va 44-maydonning ustida joylashgan IFJa maydoni.

role.en: Key cognitive-control hub at the inferior frontal junction: updates task rules and coordinates verbal working memory.
role.uz: Pastki peshona tutashuvidagi kognitiv nazorat markazi: vazifa qoidalarini yangilaydi va verbal ishchi xotirani muvofiqlashtiradi.

clinical.en: Lesions cause perseveration and difficulty switching between cognitive tasks.
clinical.uz: Zararlanishi perseveratsiya va kognitiv vazifalar orasida almashish qiyinligini beradi.

sources.title: Glasser et al. 2016, Nature — A multi-modal parcellation of human cerebral cortex

description.en: Area IFJp at the exact junction of the inferior frontal sulcus and the inferior precentral sulcus.
description.uz: Pastki peshona egati bilan pastki oldingi markaziy egat tutashgan nuqtada joylashgan IFJp maydoni.

role.en: Core multiple-demand node linking top-down attentional templates with premotor action selection.
role.uz: Yuqoridan pastga yo'nalgan diqqat andozalarini premotor harakat tanlovi bilan bog'lovchi kognitiv nazorat tuguni.

clinical.en: Lesions impair selective attention, Stroop interference control and task switching.
clinical.uz: Zararlanishi tanlovchi diqqat, Strup ziddiyatini yengish va vazifa almashtirishni buzadi.

sources.title: Glasser et al. 2016, Nature — A multi-modal parcellation of human cerebral cortex

description.en: Area IFSp along the banks of the posterior-middle inferior frontal sulcus anterior to IFJa.
description.uz: O'rta-orqa pastki peshona egati qirg'oqlari bo'ylab IFJa dan oldinda joylashgan IFSp maydoni.

role.en: Maintains phonological and rule representations in working memory during language and executive tasks.
role.uz: Til va ijrochi vazifalar davomida ishchi xotirada fonologik hamda qoida tasvirlarini saqlab turadi.

clinical.en: Lesions impair verbal working memory and complex sentence processing.
clinical.uz: Zararlanishi verbal ishchi xotira va murakkab gaplarni qayta ishlashni buzadi.

sources.title: Glasser et al. 2016, Nature — A multi-modal parcellation of human cerebral cortex

description.en: Area IFSa in the anterior inferior frontal sulcus between area 46/p9-46v dorsally and area 45/47 ventrally.
description.uz: Oldingi pastki peshona egatida dorsalda 46/p9-46v bilan ventralda 45/47 maydonlari orasida joylashgan IFSa maydoni.

role.en: Integrates semantic retrieval from the inferior frontal gyrus with dorsolateral executive working memory.
role.uz: Pastki peshona pushtasidan semantik chaqirishni dorsolateral ijrochi ishchi xotira bilan birlashtiradi.

clinical.en: Lesions impair strategic verbal retrieval and executive control.
clinical.uz: Zararlanishi strategik so'z eslash va ijrochi nazoratni buzadi.

sources.title: Glasser et al. 2016, Nature — A multi-modal parcellation of human cerebral cortex

description.en: Area p9-46v on the mid-ventral middle frontal gyrus above the inferior frontal sulcus.
description.uz: O'rta peshona pushtasining o'rta-ventral qismida, pastki peshona egati ustida joylashgan p9-46v maydoni.

role.en: Central hub of the frontoparietal executive control network: active manipulation of items in working memory and cognitive flexibility.
role.uz: Peshona-tepa ijrochi nazorat tarmog'ining markaziy tuguni: ishchi xotirada ma'lumotlarni faol qayta ishlash va kognitiv moslashuvchanlik.

clinical.en: Lesions cause classic dorsolateral prefrontal dysexecutive syndrome; main anatomical zone targeted in left DLPFC rTMS for depression.
clinical.uz: Zararlanishi klassik dorsolateral dizeksekutiv sindrom beradi; depressiyada chap DLPFC rTMS muolajasining asosiy nishoni.

sources.title: Glasser et al. 2016, Nature — A multi-modal parcellation of human cerebral cortex

description.en: Brodmann area 46 on the anterior-middle frontal gyrus dorsal to a9-46v and ventral to 9-46d.
description.uz: Oldingi-o'rta peshona pushtasida a9-46v dan dorsalda va 9-46d dan ventralda joylashgan Brodmann 46-maydoni.

role.en: Sustains abstract goals and multi-step plans in working memory while resisting distraction.
role.uz: Chalg'ituvchi ta'sirlarga bardosh bergan holda ishchi xotirada mavhum maqsadlar va ko'p bosqichli rejalarni ushlab turadi.

clinical.en: Lesions impair planning, working-memory capacity and executive behavioural organization.
clinical.uz: Zararlanishi rejalashtirish, ishchi xotira hajmi va xulqni ijrochi tashkil etishni buzadi.

sources.title: Glasser et al. 2016, Nature — A multi-modal parcellation of human cerebral cortex

description.en: Area a9-46v on the rostral middle frontal gyrus approaching the frontal pole above a47r.
description.uz: Rostral o'rta peshona pushtasida peshona qutbi yaqinida, a47r ustida joylashgan a9-46v maydoni.

role.en: High-order relational reasoning, rule abstraction and subgoal management.
role.uz: Yuqori tartibli mantiqiy mulohaza, qoidalarni umumlashtirish va oraliq maqsadlarni boshqarish.

clinical.en: Lesions impair abstract problem solving and multi-step decision making.
clinical.uz: Zararlanishi mavhum masalalarni yechish va ko'p bosqichli qaror qabul qilishni buzadi.

sources.title: Glasser et al. 2016, Nature — A multi-modal parcellation of human cerebral cortex

description.en: Area 9-46d on the dorsal middle frontal gyrus and middle frontal sulcus between area 46 and area 9.
description.uz: Dorsal o'rta peshona pushtasi va o'rta peshona egatida 46 hamda 9-maydonlar orasida joylashgan 9-46d maydoni.

role.en: Coordinates spatial and non-spatial working memory with dorsal executive control.
role.uz: Fazoviy va nofazoviy ishchi xotirani dorsal ijrochi nazorat bilan muvofiqlashtiradi.

clinical.en: Lesions cause executive dysfunction, poor planning and impaired working-memory monitoring.
clinical.uz: Zararlanishi ijrochi disfunksiya, rejalashtirish va ishchi xotira monitoringi buzilishini beradi.

sources.title: Glasser et al. 2016, Nature — A multi-modal parcellation of human cerebral cortex

description.en: Area 9a on the anterior superior/middle frontal boundary immediately behind the lateral frontal pole (10pp/a10p).
description.uz: Yuqori va o'rta peshona pushtalarining oldingi chegarasida, lateral peshona qutbi (10pp/a10p) ortida joylashgan 9a maydoni.

role.en: Supports prospective memory, self-generated abstract thought and cognitive branching.
role.uz: Kelajakka mo'ljallangan xotira, mavhum fikrlash va ko'p vazifali tarmoqlanishni ta'minlaydi.

clinical.en: Lesions impair complex real-world planning and multitasking.
clinical.uz: Zararlanishi kundalik hayotda murakkab rejalashtirish va ko'p vazifalilikni buzadi.

sources.title: Glasser et al. 2016, Nature — A multi-modal parcellation of human cerebral cortex

description.en: Area 10v at the anterior-inferior medial frontal pole continuous with the anterior gyrus rectus.
description.uz: Peshona qutbining oldingi-pastki medial qismida, oldingi to'g'ri pushtaga davom etuvchi 10v maydoni.

role.en: Ventromedial frontopolar node of the default-mode network encoding subjective reward value and future personal outcomes.
role.uz: Subyektiv mukofot qiymati va kelajakdagi shaxsiy natijalarni kodlovchi ventromedial peshona qutbi default-mode tuguni.

clinical.en: Damaged in frontobasal trauma or olfactory groove meningiomas, impairing value-based judgement.
clinical.uz: Frontobazal travma yoki hid egati meningiomalarida zararlanib, qiymatga asoslangan mulohazani buzadi.

sources.title: Glasser et al. 2016, Nature — A multi-modal parcellation of human cerebral cortex

description.en: Area a10p on the anterolateral apex of the frontal pole.
description.uz: Peshona qutbining oldingi-lateral cho'qqisida joylashgan a10p maydoni.

role.en: Rostral frontopolar executive hub for cognitive branching (holding a primary goal on hold while exploring alternatives).
role.uz: Asosiy maqsadni yodda saqlagan holda muqobil yo'llarni tekshirish (kognitiv tarmoqlanish) uchun rostral peshona qutbi markazi.

clinical.en: Frontal pole contusions cause multitasking failure and impaired prospective memory.
clinical.uz: Peshona qutbi kontuziyasi ko'p vazifani bajara olmaslik va kelajakka mo'ljallangan xotira buzilishini beradi.

sources.title: Glasser et al. 2016, Nature — A multi-modal parcellation of human cerebral cortex

description.en: Area 10pp at the dorsal tip of the frontal pole between 10d medially and a10p ventrolaterally.
description.uz: Peshona qutbining dorsal uchida, medialda 10d bilan ventrolateralda a10p orasida joylashgan 10pp maydoni.

role.en: Metacognitive monitoring, confidence judgement and integration of internal thoughts with external goals.
role.uz: Metakognitiv monitoring, o'z qaroriga ishonchni baholash va ichki fikrlarni tashqi maqsadlar bilan birlashtirish.

clinical.en: Lesions reduce metacognitive insight and strategic planning.
clinical.uz: Zararlanishi o'z holatini tanqidiy anglash (metakognitsiya) va strategik rejalashtirishni pasaytiradi.

sources.title: Glasser et al. 2016, Nature — A multi-modal parcellation of human cerebral cortex

description.en: Area 11l on the anterior orbital surface of the frontal lobe between the olfactory sulcus and lateral orbital sulcus.
description.uz: Peshona bo'lagining oldingi orbital yuzasida hid bilish egati bilan lateral orbital egat orasida joylashgan 11l maydoni.

role.en: Evaluates sensory reward value (food, odour, visual cues) and updates choices when reward contingencies change (sensory-specific satiety).
role.uz: Sezgi mukofoti qiymatini (ta'm, hid, ko'ruv belgilari) baholaydi va sharoit o'zgarganda tanlovni yangilaydi.

clinical.en: Orbitofrontal trauma or tumours here cause disinhibition, impulsivity and poor financial/social judgement.
clinical.uz: Bu yerdagi orbitofrontal travma yoki o'smalar tormozsizlik, impulsivlik va ijtimoiy mulohaza buzilishini beradi.

sources.title: Glasser et al. 2016, Nature — A multi-modal parcellation of human cerebral cortex

description.en: Area 13l on the posterior orbital gyrus anterior to the anterior perforated substance and insula.
description.uz: Orqa orbital pushtada oldingi ilma-teshik modda va orolcha oldida joylashgan 13l maydoni.

role.en: Dysgranular posterior orbitofrontal cortex integrating olfactory, gustatory and visceral signals with amygdala emotional input.
role.uz: Hid, ta'm va visseral signallarni amigdala emotsional kirishi bilan birlashtiruvchi disgranulyar orqa orbitofrontal po'stloq.

clinical.en: Lesions disrupt emotional conditioning, autonomic responses to social cues and impulse control.
clinical.uz: Zararlanishi emotsional shartli reflekslarni, ijtimoiy ishoralarga vegetativ javobni va impuls nazoratini buzadi.

sources.title: Glasser et al. 2016, Nature — A multi-modal parcellation of human cerebral cortex

description.en: Medial orbital frontal complex spanning the gyrus rectus and olfactory sulcus on the ventromedial orbital surface.
description.uz: Ventromedial orbital yuzada to'g'ri pushta (gyrus rectus) va hid bilish egatini qamrab olgan medial orbitofrontal kompleks (OFC).

role.en: Primary reward-valuation hub computing subjective pleasantness and expected value in decision making.
role.uz: Qaror qabul qilishda subyektiv yoqimlilik va kutilayotgan mukofot qiymatini hisoblovchi asosiy markaz.

clinical.en: Lesions (AComA aneurysm rupture, olfactory groove meningioma, trauma) impair value-based decision making and emotional regulation.
clinical.uz: Zararlanishi (AComA anevrizmasi, hid egati meningiomasi, travma) qiymatga asoslangan qaror qabul qilish va emotsional boshqaruvni buzadi.

sources.title: Glasser et al. 2016, Nature — A multi-modal parcellation of human cerebral cortex

description.en: Area 47s on the posterior-medial orbital/opercular transition near the limen insulae lateral to area 13l.
description.uz: Limen insulae yaqinida 13l maydonidan lateralda, orqa-medial orbital va qopqoq o'tish joyida joylashgan 47s maydoni.

role.en: Links orbitofrontal reward/visceral circuits with anterior insular salience and ventrolateral prefrontal semantic networks.
role.uz: Orbitofrontal mukofot/visseral zanjirlarni oldingi orolcha salience va ventrolateral prefrontal semantik tarmoqlari bilan bog'laydi.

clinical.en: Involved in frontotemporal lobar degeneration and mood/anxiety network dysfunction.
clinical.uz: Peshona-chakka degeneratsiyasi hamda kayfiyat va xavotir tarmoqlari disfunksiyasida ishtirok etadi.

sources.title: Glasser et al. 2016, Nature — A multi-modal parcellation of human cerebral cortex

description.en: Area LIPd on the upper bank of the mid-intraparietal sulcus immediately dorsal to LIPv.
description.uz: O'rta tepa ichi egatining yuqori devorida LIPv ning bevosita ustida joylashgan LIPd maydoni.

role.en: Top-down visuospatial attention and oculomotor saccade planning within the frontoparietal dorsal attention network.
role.uz: Peshona-tepa dorsal diqqat tarmog'ida ko'ruv-fazoviy diqqat va sakkadalarni rejalashtirishni ta'minlaydi.

clinical.en: Right-hemisphere lesions contribute to contralateral hemispatial neglect.
clinical.uz: O'ng yarim shardagi zararlanishi qarama-qarshi gemispatial e'tiborsizlikka (neglect) olib keladi.

sources.title: Glasser et al. 2016, Nature — A multi-modal parcellation of human cerebral cortex

description.en: Area 6a on the posterior superior and middle frontal gyri rostral to area 6d and dorsal to the frontal eye field.
description.uz: Orqa yuqori va o'rta peshona pushtalarida 6d maydonidan oldinda va peshona ko'z maydonidan dorsalda joylashgan 6a maydoni.

role.en: Rostral dorsal premotor cortex (pre-PMd): links abstract cognitive rules and spatial attention with motor preparation.
role.uz: Rostral dorsal premotor po'stloq (pre-PMd): mavhum kognitiv qoidalar va fazoviy diqqatni harakatga tayyorgarlik bilan bog'laydi.

clinical.en: Lesions impair conditional visuomotor learning (selecting actions based on arbitrary visual symbols) and writing (Exner region).
clinical.uz: Zararlanishi shartli vizuomotor o'rganishni va yozishni (Eksner sohasi) buzadi.

sources.title: Glasser et al. 2016, Nature — A multi-modal parcellation of human cerebral cortex

description.en: Area i6-8 on the middle frontal gyrus at the transition between rostral premotor area 6a and prefrontal area 8.
description.uz: O'rta peshona pushtasida rostral premotor 6a bilan prefrontal 8-maydon orasidagi pastki 6–8 o'tish maydoni (i6-8).

role.en: Multiple-demand executive node bridging cognitive working memory with premotor action selection.
role.uz: Kognitiv ishchi xotirani premotor harakat tanlovi bilan bog'lovchi ijrochi nazorat tuguni.

clinical.en: Lesions impair executive control and rule-guided motor sequencing.
clinical.uz: Zararlanishi ijrochi nazorat va qoidaga asoslangan harakat ketma-ketligini buzadi.

sources.title: Glasser et al. 2016, Nature — A multi-modal parcellation of human cerebral cortex

description.en: Area s6-8 on the dorsal superior frontal gyrus between premotor area 6a and prefrontal area 8Ad/8BL.
description.uz: Dorsal yuqori peshona pushtasida premotor 6a bilan prefrontal 8Ad/8BL maydonlari orasida joylashgan s6-8 maydoni.

role.en: Coordinates spatial working memory and top-down attentional control of goal-directed actions.
