role.uz: Maqsadga yo'naltirilgan harakatlarda fazoviy ishchi xotira va diqqat nazoratini muvofiqlashtiradi.

clinical.en: Lesions contribute to dorsal frontal executive and spatial working-memory deficits.
clinical.uz: Zararlanishi dorsal peshona ijrochi va fazoviy ishchi xotira nuqsoniga hissa qo'shadi.

sources.title: Glasser et al. 2016, Nature — A multi-modal parcellation of human cerebral cortex

description.en: Brodmann area 43 on the subcentral gyrus (Rolandic operculum) at the lower end of the central sulcus.
description.uz: Markaziy egatning pastki uchidagi subsentral pushtada (Roland qopqog'i) joylashgan Brodmann 43-maydoni.

role.en: Sensorimotor representation of the oral cavity, pharynx, larynx and swallowing, adjoining the gustatory cortex.
role.uz: Og'iz bo'shlig'i, halqum, hiqildoq va yutishning sensomotor vakilligi; ta'm bilish po'stlog'iga tutashgan.

clinical.en: Lesions cause dysarthria and neurogenic dysphagia (bi-opercular Foix–Chavany–Marie syndrome when bilateral).
clinical.uz: Zararlanishi dizartriya va neyrogen disfagiya beradi (ikki tomonlama bo'lsa Fua–Shavani–Mari sindromi).

sources.title: Glasser et al. 2016, Nature — A multi-modal parcellation of human cerebral cortex

gl-area-op4-pv.uz: Tepa qopqog'i OP4/PV maydoni (parietal ventral S2)

description.en: Area OP4 (parietal ventral somatosensory area, PV) on the anterior parietal operculum immediately behind area 43.
description.uz: Oldingi tepa qopqog'ida 43-maydonning bevosita ortida joylashgan OP4 (parietal ventral ikkilamchi somatosensor, PV) maydoni.

role.en: Anterior division of secondary somatosensory cortex (S2): integrates bilateral tactile feedback with motor control of the hand and vocal tract.
role.uz: Ikkilamchi somatosensor po'stloqning (S2) oldingi qismi: ikki tomonlama taktil qayta aloqani qo'l va nutq harakati nazorati bilan birlashtiradi.

clinical.en: Lesions impair sensorimotor tactile guidance of hand manipulation and speech articulation.
clinical.uz: Zararlanishi qo'l manipulyatsiyasi va nutq artikulyatsiyasining taktil-sensomotor nazoratini buzadi.

sources.title: Glasser et al. 2016, Nature — A multi-modal parcellation of human cerebral cortex

description.en: Area OP1 (human SII proper) on the posterior-lateral parietal operculum in the upper bank of the Sylvian fissure.
description.uz: Silviy egatining yuqori qirg'og'ida, orqa-lateral tepa qopqog'ida joylashgan OP1 (xususiy ikkilamchi somatosensor, SII) maydoni.

role.en: Processes bilateral tactile discrimination, tool-related touch, tactile working memory and pain perception.
role.uz: Ikki tomonlama taktil farqlash, asbob ishlatish sezgisi, taktil ishchi xotira va og'riq idrokini qayta ishlaydi.

clinical.en: Lesions cause tactile agnosia or central opercular pain syndromes.
clinical.uz: Zararlanishi taktil agnoziya yoki markaziy qopqoq og'riq sindromlarini keltirib chiqaradi.

sources.title: Glasser et al. 2016, Nature — A multi-modal parcellation of human cerebral cortex

description.en: Area OP2-3 deeply buried in the medial parietal operculum at the junction with the posterior circular sulcus of the insula.
description.uz: Medial tepa qopqog'i tubida, orolcha orqa halqasimon egati bilan tutashuvda joylashgan OP2-3 (vestibulyar) maydoni.

role.en: Core human parieto-insular vestibular cortex (PIVC): integrates semicircular-canal and otolith signals with proprioception for balance and verticality.
role.uz: Odamning asosiy tepa-orolcha vestibulyar po'stlog'i (PIVC): muvozanat va vertikallik hissi uchun dahliz-yarim halqa kanallari signallarini propriosepsiya bilan birlashtiradi.

clinical.en: Acute strokes here shift the perceived subjective visual vertical and cause cortical vertigo or Lateropulsion (pusher syndrome).
clinical.uz: O'tkir insulti subyektiv ko'ruv vertikali og'ishini, kortikal bosh aylanishini yoki tana og'ishini (pusher sindromi) chaqiradi.

sources.title: Glasser et al. 2016, Nature — A multi-modal parcellation of human cerebral cortex

description.en: Brodmann area 52 on the medial surface of Heschl’s gyrus at the junction of the temporal operculum and posterior insula.
description.uz: Geshl pushtasining medial qismida, chakka qopqog'i bilan orqa orolcha tutashgan joydagi Brodmann 52-maydoni.

role.en: Medial auditory belt / parainsular transition zone integrating auditory signals with somatosensory and visceral inputs.
role.uz: Eshituv signallarini somatosensor va visseral kirishlar bilan birlashtiruvchi medial eshituv kamari / parainsulyar o'tish zonasi.

clinical.en: Involved in perisylvian auditory-autonomic processing and auditory auras.
clinical.uz: Perisilviy eshituv-vegetativ integratsiya va eshituv auralarida ishtirok etadi.

sources.title: Glasser et al. 2016, Nature — A multi-modal parcellation of human cerebral cortex

description.en: Retroinsular area (RI) at the posterior end of the Sylvian fissure behind the posterior insula and medial to Heschl’s gyrus.
description.uz: Silviy egatining orqa uchida, orqa orolcha ortida va Geshl pushtasidan medialda joylashgan retroinsulyar po'stloq (RI).

role.en: Multisensory convergence zone combining vestibular, somatosensory and auditory motion cues.
role.uz: Vestibulyar, somatosensor va eshituv harakat signallarini birlashtiruvchi ko'p sezgili konvergensiya zonasi.

clinical.en: Lesions contribute to vestibular spatial disorientation and central pain.
clinical.uz: Zararlanishi vestibulyar fazoviy dezoriyentatsiya va markaziy og'riqqa hissa qo'shadi.

sources.title: Glasser et al. 2016, Nature — A multi-modal parcellation of human cerebral cortex

description.en: Area PFcm in the posterior Sylvian fissure on the upper bank of the parietal operculum behind OP1 and ventral to PF/PFop.
description.uz: Orqa Silviy egatining yuqori qirg'og'ida, OP1 ortida va PF/PFop ostida joylashgan PFcm maydoni.

role.en: Integrates auditory, somatosensory and vocal-motor signals for speech monitoring and peripersonal action.
role.uz: Nutqni nazorat qilish va yaqin fazodagi harakatlar uchun eshituv, somatosensor hamda ovoz-harakat signallarini birlashtiradi.

clinical.en: Dominant lesions contribute to conduction aphasia and phonological repetition deficits.
clinical.uz: Dominant yarim shardagi zararlanishi o'tkazuvchi afaziya va fonologik takrorlash buzilishiga olib keladi.

sources.title: Glasser et al. 2016, Nature — A multi-modal parcellation of human cerebral cortex

description.en: Area PoI2 on the dorsal-anterior portion of the posterior long insular gyri.
description.uz: Orqa orolchaning uzun pushtalari dorsal-oldingi qismida joylashgan PoI2 maydoni.

role.en: Somato-visceral and nociceptive insular cortex mapping graded temperature, pinprick pain and interoceptive bodily state.
role.uz: Harorat, sanchuvchi og'riq va ichki a'zolar (interotseptiv) holatini xaritalovchi somato-visseral orolcha po'stlog'i.

clinical.en: Posterior insular strokes can produce central neuropathic pain (pseudothalamic syndrome) or loss of pain affect.
clinical.uz: Orqa orolcha insulti markaziy neyropatik og'riq (psevdotalamik sindrom) yoki og'riq hissining o'zgarishini beradi.

sources.title: Glasser et al. 2016, Nature — A multi-modal parcellation of human cerebral cortex

description.en: Area TA2 on the planum polare of the anterior superior temporal gyrus just in front of Heschl’s gyrus and the auditory belt.
description.uz: Oldingi yuqori chakka pushtasining planum polare yuzasida, Geshl pushtasi va eshituv kamarining bevosita oldida joylashgan TA2 maydoni.

role.en: Anterior auditory parabelt processing complex vocalizations, speech melody and environmental sound identity.
role.uz: Murakkab ovozlar, nutq ohangi va atrof-muhit tovushlarini tanib oluvchi oldingi eshituv parabelt po'stlog'i.

clinical.en: Lesions impair recognition of complex sounds, music and speaker voices.
clinical.uz: Zararlanishi murakkab tovushlar, musiqa va suhbatdosh ovozini tanishni buzadi.

sources.title: Glasser et al. 2016, Nature — A multi-modal parcellation of human cerebral cortex

description.en: Area FOP4 on the inner surface of the frontal operculum facing the anterior superior circular sulcus of the insula.
description.uz: Peshona qopqog'ining ichki yuzasida, orolchaning oldingi-yuqori halqasimon egatiga qaragan FOP4 maydoni.

role.en: Node of the cingulo-opercular salience and task-control network; also participates in articulatory and gustatory processing.
role.uz: Belbog'-qopqoq salience va vazifa nazorati tarmog'i tuguni; artikulyatsiya va ta'm qayta ishlovida ham qatnashadi.

clinical.en: Lesions impair tonic alertness, task maintenance and speech motor coordination.
clinical.uz: Zararlanishi hushyorlikni saqlash, vazifa nazorati va nutq harakati muvofiqligini buzadi.

sources.title: Glasser et al. 2016, Nature — A multi-modal parcellation of human cerebral cortex

description.en: Middle insular area (MI) on the posterior short insular gyri just in front of the central sulcus of the insula.
description.uz: Orolcha markaziy egatining bevosita oldida, orqa qisqa orolcha pushtalarida joylashgan o'rta orolcha maydoni (MI).

role.en: Dysgranular bridge translating posterior insular interoceptive/pain signals into anterior insular conscious feelings and autonomic responses.
role.uz: Orqa orolchadagi interotseptiv/og'riq signallarini oldingi orolchadagi ongli his-tuyg'u va vegetativ javoblarga aylantiruvchi ko'prik.

clinical.en: Insular strokes or epileptic discharges here trigger autonomic instability, viscerosensory auras and dysarthria.
clinical.uz: Bu yerdagi insult yoki epileptik tutqanoqlar vegetativ beqarorlik, visserosensor auralar va dizartriya chaqiradi.

sources.title: Glasser et al. 2016, Nature — A multi-modal parcellation of human cerebral cortex

description.en: Piriform cortex spanning the frontal-temporal junction at the limen insulae and adjacent dorsomedial uncus.
description.uz: Limen insulae'dagi peshona-chakka tutashuvi va yondosh dorsomedial uncusda joylashgan noksimon (piriform) po'stloq.

role.en: Primary olfactory cortex: receives direct axons from the olfactory bulb via the lateral olfactory stria to encode odour identity.
role.uz: Birlamchi hid bilish po'stlog'i: hidni tanish uchun lateral hid yo'li orqali hid piyozchasidan bevosita aksonlarni qabul qiladi.

clinical.en: Hyperexcitable focus in temporal lobe epilepsy causing classic uncinate fits (unpleasant olfactory hallucinations); early pathology in Parkinson and Alzheimer diseases.
clinical.uz: Chakka epilepsiyasida yoqimsiz hid gallyutsinatsiyalarini (unkal tutqanoqlar) chaqiruvchi o'choq; Parkinson va Alzheimer kasalliklarida erta zararlanadi.

sources.title: Glasser et al. 2016, Nature — A multi-modal parcellation of human cerebral cortex

description.en: Area AVI on the anterior-superior apex of the short insular gyri adjacent to the frontal operculum (FOP4/FOP5).
description.uz: Qisqa orolcha pushtalarining oldingi-yuqori cho'qqisida, peshona qopqog'i (FOP4/FOP5) yonida joylashgan AVI maydoni.

role.en: Core cognitive-salience hub of the anterior insula: detects behaviourally important stimuli and switches between default-mode and executive networks.
role.uz: Oldingi orolchaning asosiy kognitiv-salience markazi: muhim ta'sirlarni aniqlaydi hamda default-mode va ijrochi tarmoqlar orasida almashishni boshqaradi.

clinical.en: Dysfunction is linked to anxiety, addiction craving, frontotemporal dementia and executive slowing.
clinical.uz: Disfunksiyasi xavotir, giyohvandlik xumori, peshona-chakka demensiyasi va ijrochi sekinlashuv bilan bog'liq.

sources.title: Glasser et al. 2016, Nature — A multi-modal parcellation of human cerebral cortex

description.en: Area AAIC on the ventral-anterior insula above the limen insulae and piriform cortex.
description.uz: Ventral-oldingi orolchada limen insulae va noksimon po'stloq ustida joylashgan oldingi agranulyar orolcha kompleksi (AAIC).

role.en: Agranular visceromotor and socio-emotional insula (rich in von Economo neurons): subjective emotion, empathy, disgust and autonomic outflow.
role.uz: Fon Ekonomo neyronlariga boy agranulyar visseromotor va ijtimoiy-emotsional orolcha: subyektiv hissiyot, empatiya, jirkanish va vegetativ boshqaruv.

clinical.en: Selectively and severely degenerates in behavioural-variant frontotemporal dementia (bvFTD), causing loss of empathy and social warmth.
clinical.uz: Xulqiy peshona-chakka demensiyasida (bvFTD) tanlab degeneratsiyalanib, empatiya va ijtimoiy hislarning yo'qolishiga olib keladi.

sources.title: Glasser et al. 2016, Nature — A multi-modal parcellation of human cerebral cortex

description.en: Area FOP1 on the posterior inner wall of the frontal operculum adjacent to area 6r and OP4.
description.uz: Peshona qopqog'ining orqa ichki devorida, 6r va OP4 maydonlari yonida joylashgan FOP1 maydoni.

role.en: Orofacial, laryngeal and gustatory opercular cortex supporting speech articulation and swallowing.
role.uz: Nutq artikulyatsiyasi va yutishni ta'minlovchi yuz-og'iz, hiqildoq va ta'm qopqoq po'stlog'i.

clinical.en: Lesions contribute to opercular dysarthria and dysphagia.
clinical.uz: Zararlanishi qopqoq dizartriyasi va disfagiyasiga hissa qo'shadi.

sources.title: Glasser et al. 2016, Nature — A multi-modal parcellation of human cerebral cortex

description.en: Area FOP3 on the deep medial wall of the frontal operculum in the superior circular sulcus of the insula between FOP2 and FOP4.
description.uz: Orolchaning yuqori halqasimon egatida, peshona qopqog'ining chuqur medial devorida FOP2 va FOP4 orasida joylashgan FOP3 maydoni.

role.en: Integrates primary gustatory (taste) input from VPMpc with interoceptive and articulatory signals.
role.uz: VPMpc yadrosidan keluvchi birlamchi ta'm kirishini interotseptiv va artikulyator signallar bilan birlashtiradi.

clinical.en: Lesions can cause dysgeusia/ageusia and opercular motor speech deficits.
clinical.uz: Zararlanishi ta'm bilish buzilishi (disgevziya/agevziya) va nutq harakati nuqsonini beradi.

sources.title: Glasser et al. 2016, Nature — A multi-modal parcellation of human cerebral cortex

description.en: Area FOP2 on the inner frontal operculum between FOP1 posteriorly and FOP3 anteriorly.
description.uz: Ichki peshona qopqog'ida orqada FOP1 bilan oldinda FOP3 orasida joylashgan FOP2 maydoni.

role.en: Coordinates somatosensory feedback from the mouth and tongue with premotor articulatory commands.
role.uz: Og'iz va tildan keluvchi somatosensor qayta aloqani premotor artikulyator buyruqlar bilan muvofiqlashtiradi.

clinical.en: Dominant lesions impair articulatory precision and speech initiation.
clinical.uz: Dominant yarim shardagi zararlanishi artikulyatsiya aniqligini va nutqni boshlashni buzadi.

sources.title: Glasser et al. 2016, Nature — A multi-modal parcellation of human cerebral cortex

description.en: Area PFt on the anterior crown of the supramarginal gyrus immediately behind the postcentral sulcus (area 2) and ventral to AIP.
description.uz: Chekka usti pushtasining oldingi cho'qqisida, orqa markaziy egat (2-maydon) ortida va AIP ostida joylashgan PFt maydoni.

role.en: Core node of the human tool-use and action-observation network: translates visual object affordances into skilled hand actions.
role.uz: Odamda asbob ishlatish va harakatni kuzatish tarmog'ining asosiy tuguni: narsa ko'rinishini mohir qo'l harakatlariga aylantiradi.

clinical.en: Left PFt lesions cause ideomotor and limb-kinetic apraxia (inability to pantomime or properly use tools).
clinical.uz: Chap PFt zararlanishi ideomotor apraksiyani (asbob ishlatishni ko'rsatib yoki bajarib bera olmaslikni) keltirib chiqaradi.

sources.title: Glasser et al. 2016, Nature — A multi-modal parcellation of human cerebral cortex

description.en: Area AIP in the anterior end of the intraparietal sulcus at its junction with the postcentral sulcus.
description.uz: Tepa ichi egatining oldingi uchida, orqa markaziy egat bilan tutashgan joyda joylashgan AIP maydoni.

role.en: Visuomotor grasping hub: extracts 3D size, shape and orientation of objects to shape the hand and fingers before contact (in loop with ventral premotor area 6v).
role.uz: Vizuomotor ushlash markazi: narsaning 3D o'lchami va shaklini tahlil qilib, ushlashdan oldin barmoqlarni moslashtiradi (ventral premotor 6v bilan halqada).

clinical.en: Lesions cause deficits in hand preshaping and fine visually guided grasping.
clinical.uz: Zararlanishi narsani ushlashda panjani oldindan moslashtirish va nozik ko'ruv-harakat nazoratini buzadi.

sources.title: Glasser et al. 2016, Nature — A multi-modal parcellation of human cerebral cortex

description.en: Entorhinal cortex (Brodmann area 28) on the anterior medial parahippocampal gyrus and uncus.
description.uz: Oldingi medial parahippokampal pushta va uncusda joylashgan entorinal po'stloq (Brodmann 28).

role.en: Main bidirectional gateway between neocortex and hippocampus via the perforant path; houses spatial grid cells for navigation and episodic memory.
role.uz: Perforant yo'l orqali neokorteks bilan gippokamp orasidagi asosiy ikki tomonlama darvoza; fazoviy mo'ljal va epizodik xotira uchun to'r hujayralarini saqlaydi.

clinical.en: Earliest cortical site of neurofibrillary tau pathology in Alzheimer disease (Braak stages I–II).
clinical.uz: Alzheimer kasalligida neyrofibrillyar tau patologiyasining eng erta po'stloq joyi (Braak I–II bosqichlari).

sources.title: Glasser et al. 2016, Nature — A multi-modal parcellation of human cerebral cortex

description.en: Presubiculum on the medial surface of the parahippocampal gyrus between the subiculum of the hippocampus and the entorhinal/retrosplenial cortex.
description.uz: Parahippokampal pushtaning medial yuzasida gippokamp subikulumi bilan entorinal/retrosplenial po'stloq orasida joylashgan presubikulum (PreS).

role.en: Rich in head-direction cells; relays vestibular and visual landmark azimuth between Papez circuit nuclei (anterior thalamus), retrosplenial cortex and entorhinal grid cells.
role.uz: Bosh yo'nalishi hujayralariga boy; Papez zanjiri (oldingi talamus), retrosplenial po'stloq va entorinal to'r hujayralari orasida fazoviy yo'nalishni uzatadi.

clinical.en: Early amyloid and tau involvement in Alzheimer disease contributes to spatial disorientation.
clinical.uz: Alzheimer kasalligida erta zararlanib, fazoviy mo'ljal yo'qolishiga olib keladi.

sources.title: Glasser et al. 2016, Nature — A multi-modal parcellation of human cerebral cortex

description.en: Hippocampal proper and subiculum parcel along the medial temporal horn floor in the HCP-MMP1 cortical surface model.
description.uz: HCP-MMP1 po'stloq yuzasi modelida yon qorincha chakka shoxi medial tubi bo'ylab joylashgan gippokamp va subikulum sohasi.

role.en: Forms and consolidates new declarative/episodic memories and builds cognitive spatial maps via place cells.
role.uz: Yangi deklarativ/epizodik xotiralarni shakllantiradi va mustahkamlaydi hamda joy hujayralari orqali fazoviy kognitiv xarita tuzadi.

clinical.en: Bilateral damage (anoxia, HSV encephalitis, resection) causes profound anterograde amnesia; hippocampal sclerosis is the classic lesion of mesial temporal lobe epilepsy.
clinical.uz: Ikki tomonlama zararlanishi og'ir anterograd amneziya beradi; gippokampal skleroz mezial chakka epilepsiyasining klassik o'chog'i.

sources.title: Glasser et al. 2016, Nature — A multi-modal parcellation of human cerebral cortex

description.en: Prostriate cortex (ProS) at the anterior junction of the calcarine sulcus and parieto-occipital sulcus immediately behind the retrosplenial complex.
description.uz: Kalkarin egat bilan tepa-ensa egati tutashgan oldingi burchakda, retrosplenial kompleksning bevosita ortida joylashgan prostriar po'stloq (ProS).

role.en: Primitive limbic visual area with ultra-fast response to peripheral visual motion, linking far-peripheral V1 directly with limbic/retrosplenial orientation circuits.
role.uz: Uzoq periferik ko'rish maydonidagi harakatga juda tez javob beruvchi limbik ko'ruv maydoni; V1 ni bevosita retrosplenial mo'ljal zanjirlari bilan bog'laydi.

clinical.en: Lesions impair rapid orienting to far-peripheral visual motion and scene navigation.
clinical.uz: Zararlanishi uzoq periferik harakatga tez yo'nalish va manzara bo'yicha mo'ljal olishni buzadi.

sources.title: Glasser et al. 2016, Nature — A multi-modal parcellation of human cerebral cortex

description.en: Perirhinal and ectorhinal cortex (Brodmann areas 35 and 36) along the banks of the rhinal and anterior collateral sulci lateral to the entorhinal cortex.
description.uz: Entorinal po'stloqdan lateralda, rinal va oldingi kollateral egatlar qirg'oqlari bo'ylab joylashgan peririnal hamda ektorinal po'stloq (Brodmann 35 va 36).

role.en: Apex of the ventral object-recognition stream: encodes item familiarity, fine feature conjunctions and semantic object memory for the hippocampus.
role.uz: Ventral narsa tanish oqimining cho'qqisi: gippokamp uchun narsaning tanishlik hissini, nozik belgilar birikmasini va semantik xotirani kodlaydi.

clinical.en: Transentorhinal/perirhinal area 35 is the very first site of neurofibrillary tangle formation in Alzheimer disease (Braak stage I).
clinical.uz: Transentorinal/peririnal 35-maydon Alzheimer kasalligida neyrofibrillyar tau chigallari paydo bo'ladigan eng birinchi nuqta (Braak I bosqichi).

sources.title: Glasser et al. 2016, Nature — A multi-modal parcellation of human cerebral cortex

description.en: Area STGa on the anterior lateral superior temporal gyrus behind the dorsal temporal pole (TGd) and below TA2.
description.uz: Oldingi lateral yuqori chakka pushtasida dorsal chakka qutbi (TGd) ortida va TA2 ostida joylashgan STGa maydoni.

role.en: Anterior auditory-semantic pathway processing voice identity, vocal emotion and spoken phrase comprehension.
role.uz: Ovoz egasini, ovozdagi hissiyotni va og'zaki iboralarni tushunishni qayta ishlovchi oldingi eshituv-semantik yo'l.

clinical.en: Atrophies early in semantic dementia (svPPA); lesions impair voice and anterior language comprehension.
clinical.uz: Semantik demensiyada (svPPA) erta atrofiyalanadi; zararlanishi ovoz tanish va nutqni tushunishni buzadi.

sources.title: Glasser et al. 2016, Nature — A multi-modal parcellation of human cerebral cortex

description.en: Parabelt auditory cortex (PBelt) on the lateral edge of the superior temporal plane and upper STG lateral to the lateral belt (LBelt).
description.uz: Yuqori chakka tekisligining lateral chekkasida, lateral eshituv kamaridan (LBelt) tashqarida joylashgan parabelt eshituv kompleksi (PBelt).

role.en: Third stage of cortical auditory processing: extracts spectrotemporal speech phonemes, pitch contours and environmental sound patterns.
role.uz: Po'stloq eshituv tahlilining uchinchi bosqichi: nutq fonemalari, ohang konturlari va tabiiy tovush andozalarini ajratadi.

clinical.en: Left lesions cause pure word deafness or Wernicke-spectrum auditory comprehension deficits; right lesions cause amusia.
clinical.uz: Chap zararlanishi sof so'z karligi yoki Vernike turidagi tushunish buzilishini, o'ng zararlanishi amuziyani beradi.

sources.title: Glasser et al. 2016, Nature — A multi-modal parcellation of human cerebral cortex

description.en: Area A5 on the lateral superior temporal gyrus immediately ventral to A4 and dorsal to the superior temporal sulcus.
description.uz: Lateral yuqori chakka pushtasida A4 maydonidan bevosita ventralda va yuqori chakka egatidan dorsalda joylashgan A5 eshituv kompleksi.

role.en: High-level auditory association cortex linking acoustic phoneme and prosody representations with the superior temporal sulcus language network.
role.uz: Akustik fonema va intonatsiya tasvirlarini yuqori chakka egati til tarmog'i bilan bog'lovchi yuqori darajali eshituv assotsiativ po'stlog'i.

clinical.en: Dominant lesions impair spoken word recognition and auditory sentence comprehension.
clinical.uz: Dominant yarim shardagi zararlanishi og'zaki so'zlarni tanish va eshitib tushunishni buzadi.

sources.title: Glasser et al. 2016, Nature — A multi-modal parcellation of human cerebral cortex

description.en: Area PHA1 on the medial bank of the posterior parahippocampal gyrus adjacent to the presubiculum.
description.uz: Orqa parahippokampal pushtaning medial qirg'og'ida, presubikulum yonida joylashgan PHA1 maydoni.

role.en: Medial division of the parahippocampal place area (PPA): connects visual scene layout directly to the hippocampal formation.
role.uz: Parahippokampal joy sohasining (PPA) medial bo'limi: ko'ruv manzarasi tuzilishini bevosita gippokampal formatsiya bilan bog'laydi.

clinical.en: Lesions impair spatial scene encoding and landmark navigation.
clinical.uz: Zararlanishi fazoviy manzarani eslab qolish va mo'ljal bo'yicha yo'l topishni buzadi.

sources.title: Glasser et al. 2016, Nature — A multi-modal parcellation of human cerebral cortex

description.en: Area PHA3 on the lateral bank of the collateral sulcus between PHA2 medially and the fusiform/VVC cortex laterally.
description.uz: Kollateral egatning lateral qirg'og'ida, medialda PHA2 bilan lateralda duksimon po'stloq orasida joylashgan PHA3 maydoni.

role.en: Lateral division of the parahippocampal place area integrating large-scale object and scene features.
role.uz: Yirik narsalar va manzara belgilarini birlashtiruvchi parahippokampal joy sohasining lateral bo'limi.

clinical.en: Posterior cerebral artery infarcts here cause landmark agnosia (inability to recognise buildings and landscapes).
clinical.uz: Bu yerdagi orqa miya arteriyasi infarkti binolar va manzaralarni taniy olmaslik (topografik agnoziya) beradi.

sources.title: Glasser et al. 2016, Nature — A multi-modal parcellation of human cerebral cortex

description.en: Area STSda on the anterior-dorsal bank of the superior temporal sulcus below STGa and A5.
description.uz: Yuqori chakka egatining oldingi-dorsal qirg'og'ida, STGa va A5 ostida joylashgan STSda maydoni.

role.en: Anterior dorsal STS language and social-voice node: processes intelligible speech, voice identity and narrative meaning.
role.uz: Tushunarli nutq, ovoz egasi va hikoya mazmunini qayta ishlovchi oldingi-dorsal STS til va ijtimoiy ovoz tuguni.

clinical.en: Dominant lesions impair auditory sentence comprehension and semantic integration.
clinical.uz: Dominant zararlanishi gaplarni eshitib tushunish va semantik integratsiyani buzadi.

sources.title: Glasser et al. 2016, Nature — A multi-modal parcellation of human cerebral cortex

description.en: Area STSdp on the posterior-dorsal bank of the superior temporal sulcus ventral to A5 and anterior to STV.
description.uz: Yuqori chakka egatining orqa-dorsal qirg'og'ida, A5 ostida va STV oldida joylashgan STSdp maydoni.

role.en: Audiovisual speech and social-perception hub integrating lip movement with spoken phonemes and vocal prosody.
role.uz: Lab harakatini nutq fonemalari va ovoz ohangi bilan birlashtiruvchi audiovizual nutq hamda ijtimoiy idrok markazi.

clinical.en: Left lesions cause Wernicke-like comprehension deficits; right lesions impair prosody and social cue perception.
clinical.uz: Chap zararlanishi Vernike turidagi tushunish buzilishini, o'ng zararlanishi intonatsiya va ijtimoiy ishoralar idrokini buzadi.

sources.title: Glasser et al. 2016, Nature — A multi-modal parcellation of human cerebral cortex

description.en: Area STSvp on the posterior-ventral bank of the superior temporal sulcus above TE1p/PHT.
description.uz: Yuqori chakka egatining orqa-ventral qirg'og'ida, TE1p/PHT ustida joylashgan STSvp maydoni.

role.en: Core language-comprehension and theory-of-mind area linking visual/auditory inputs with conceptual semantic networks.
role.uz: Ko'ruv va eshituv kirishlarini tushunchaviy semantik tarmoqlar bilan bog'lovchi asosiy tilni tushunish va mentalizatsiya maydoni.

clinical.en: Dominant lesions cause severe semantic and syntactic comprehension deficits.
clinical.uz: Dominant yarim shardagi zararlanishi og'ir semantik va sintaktik tushunish buzilishini beradi.

sources.title: Glasser et al. 2016, Nature — A multi-modal parcellation of human cerebral cortex

description.en: Area TGd covering the dorsal and anterolateral apex of the temporal pole (Brodmann area 38).
description.uz: Chakka qutbining dorsal va oldingi-lateral cho'qqisini qoplagan TGd maydoni (Brodmann 38).

role.en: Transmodal semantic hub binding verbal, visual, auditory and socio-emotional knowledge about people and concepts.
role.uz: Insonlar va tushunchalar haqidagi verbal, ko'ruv, eshituv hamda ijtimoiy-emotsional bilimlarni birlashtiruvchi semantik markaz.

clinical.en: Epicentre of cortical atrophy in semantic variant primary progressive aphasia (semantic dementia).
clinical.uz: Semantik demensiyada (svPPA) po'stloq atrofiyasining asosiy markazi.

sources.title: Glasser et al. 2016, Nature — A multi-modal parcellation of human cerebral cortex

description.en: Area TE1a on the anterior crown of the middle temporal gyrus below STSva and behind TGd.
description.uz: O'rta chakka pushtasining oldingi cho'qqisida, STSva ostida va TGd ortida joylashgan TE1a maydoni.

role.en: Anterior temporal semantic and default-mode node supporting conceptual retrieval and narrative comprehension.
role.uz: Tushunchalarni eslash va matn mazmunini tushunishni ta'minlovchi oldingi chakka semantik va default-mode tuguni.

clinical.en: Atrophies early in semantic dementia, causing severe anomia and loss of word meaning.
clinical.uz: Semantik demensiyada erta atrofiyalanib, og'ir anomiya va so'z ma'nosini yo'qotishga olib keladi.

sources.title: Glasser et al. 2016, Nature — A multi-modal parcellation of human cerebral cortex

description.en: Area TE1p on the posterior-ventral middle temporal gyrus between TE1m anteriorly and PHT posteriorly.
description.uz: Orqa-ventral o'rta chakka pushtasida oldinda TE1m bilan orqada PHT orasida joylashgan TE1p maydoni.

role.en: Multimodal lexical-semantic integration hub linking visual and auditory word forms to conceptual knowledge.
role.uz: Ko'ruv va eshituv so'z shakllarini tushunchaviy bilim bilan bog'lovchi leksik-semantik integratsiya markazi.

clinical.en: Dominant lesions cause transcortical sensory aphasia and severe word-finding difficulty (anomia).
clinical.uz: Dominant zararlanishi transkortikal sensor afaziya va og'ir so'z topish qiyinligini (anomiya) beradi.

sources.title: Glasser et al. 2016, Nature — A multi-modal parcellation of human cerebral cortex

description.en: Area TE2a on the anterior-middle inferior temporal gyrus below TE1a/TE1m and lateral to TF.
description.uz: Oldingi-o'rta pastki chakka pushtasida TE1a/TE1m ostida va TF dan lateralda joylashgan TE2a maydoni.

role.en: High-level ventral visual and semantic association cortex representing object concepts and visual memory.
role.uz: Narsa tushunchalari va ko'ruv xotirasini ifodalovchi yuqori darajali ventral ko'ruv va semantik assotsiativ po'stloq.

clinical.en: Affected in semantic dementia and herpes encephalitis, causing multimodal object anomia and agnosia.
clinical.uz: Semantik demensiya va gerpetik ensefalitda zararlanib, narsalarni nomlay va taniy olmaslikni beradi.

sources.title: Glasser et al. 2016, Nature — A multi-modal parcellation of human cerebral cortex

description.en: Area TF on the anterior basal occipitotemporal surface (anterior fusiform gyrus) lateral to the perirhinal/parahippocampal cortex.
description.uz: Oldingi pastki ensa-chakka yuzasida (oldingi duksimon pushta), peririnal va parahippokampal po'stloqdan lateralda joylashgan TF maydoni.

role.en: Ventral visual stream bridge funneling high-level face, word and object representations into the perirhinal/hippocampal memory system.
role.uz: Yuqori darajali yuz, so'z va narsa tasvirlarini peririnal/gippokampal xotira tizimiga uzatuvchi ventral ko'ruv oqimi ko'prigi.

clinical.en: Lesions impair visual recognition memory and face/object naming.
clinical.uz: Zararlanishi ko'ruv tanish xotirasini hamda yuz va narsalarni nomlashni buzadi.

sources.title: Glasser et al. 2016, Nature — A multi-modal parcellation of human cerebral cortex

description.en: Area TE2p on the posterior inferior temporal gyrus and lateral occipitotemporal sulcus lateral to the fusiform face complex.
description.uz: Orqa pastki chakka pushtasi va lateral ensa-chakka egatida, duksimon yuz kompleksidan lateralda joylashgan TE2p maydoni.

role.en: Ventral visual stream area involved in orthography/reading (visual word form network on the left) and object/body recognition.
role.uz: Chapda yozma so'zlarni o'qish (VWFA tarmog'i) hamda narsa va tana shaklini tanishda qatnashuvchi ventral ko'ruv maydoni.

clinical.en: Left lesions cause pure alexia or surface dyslexia; right lesions impair visual object/body perception.
clinical.uz: Chap zararlanishi sof aleksiya yoki disleksiya, o'ng zararlanishi narsa va tana shaklini idrok etish buzilishini beradi.

sources.title: Glasser et al. 2016, Nature — A multi-modal parcellation of human cerebral cortex

description.en: Area PHT on the posterior middle and inferior temporal gyri immediately anterior to the MT+ motion complex.
description.uz: Orqa o'rta va pastki chakka pushtalarida MT+ harakat kompleksining bevosita oldida joylashgan PHT maydoni.

role.en: Links visual motion and action perception with semantic knowledge of tools and mechanical actions.
role.uz: Ko'ruv harakati va harakat idrokini asboblar hamda mexanik harakatlar haqidagi semantik bilim bilan bog'laydi.

clinical.en: Dominant lesions impair action/verb naming and semantic understanding of tool use.
clinical.uz: Dominant yarim shardagi zararlanishi harakat/fe'llarni nomlashni va asbob vazifasini tushunishni buzadi.

sources.title: Glasser et al. 2016, Nature — A multi-modal parcellation of human cerebral cortex

description.en: Area PH at the ventrolateral temporo-occipital junction between TE2p/FFC anteriorly and PIT/FST posteriorly.
description.uz: Ventrolateral chakka-ensa tutashuvida oldinda TE2p/FFC bilan orqada PIT/FST orasida joylashgan PH maydoni.

role.en: Integrates ventral stream form/word information with dorsal/lateral motion signals.
role.uz: Ventral oqimdagi shakl va so'z ma'lumotini lateral harakat signallari bilan birlashtiradi.

clinical.en: Left lesions contribute to alexia and visual naming deficits.
clinical.uz: Chap tomonlama zararlanishi aleksiya va ko'rib nomlash buzilishiga hissa qo'shadi.

sources.title: Glasser et al. 2016, Nature — A multi-modal parcellation of human cerebral cortex

description.en: Area TPOJ1 in the posterior end of the superior temporal sulcus between STV/STSdp anteriorly and TPOJ2 posteriorly.
description.uz: Yuqori chakka egatining orqa uchida oldinda STV/STSdp bilan orqada TPOJ2 orasida joylashgan TPOJ1 maydoni.

role.en: Multisensory temporoparietal junction hub for social attention, gaze following, audiovisual speech and theory of mind.
role.uz: Ijtimoiy diqqat, nigohni kuzatish, audiovizual nutq va mentalizatsiya uchun ko'p sezgili chakka-tepa tutashuvi markazi.

clinical.en: Right lesions contribute to hemispatial neglect; left lesions impair posterior language comprehension.
clinical.uz: O'ng zararlanishi gemispatial e'tiborsizlikka, chap zararlanishi orqa til tushunish buzilishiga olib keladi.

sources.title: Glasser et al. 2016, Nature — A multi-modal parcellation of human cerebral cortex

description.en: Area TPOJ2 at the temporo-parieto-occipital junction posterior to TPOJ1 and dorsal to TPOJ3/MT+.
description.uz: Chakka-tepa-ensa chorrahasida TPOJ1 dan orqada va TPOJ3/MT+ dan dorsalda joylashgan TPOJ2 maydoni.

role.en: Ventral attention and social-cognition node reorienting attention to unexpected salient visual and auditory events.
role.uz: Kutilmagan muhim ko'ruv va eshituv hodisalariga diqqatni qayta yo'naltiruvchi ventral diqqat va ijtimoiy kognitsiya tuguni.

clinical.en: Right TPOJ lesions cause spatial neglect and out-of-body / vestibular self-location disturbances.
clinical.uz: O'ng TPOJ zararlanishi fazoviy e'tiborsizlik va tana joylashuvi hissi buzilishini beradi.

sources.title: Glasser et al. 2016, Nature — A multi-modal parcellation of human cerebral cortex

description.en: Area TPOJ3 immediately anterior-dorsal to the MT+ motion complex and ventral to TPOJ2/PGp.
description.uz: MT+ harakat kompleksining bevosita oldi va ustida, TPOJ2/PGp ostida joylashgan TPOJ3 maydoni.

role.en: Bridges visual motion (MT+) with inferior parietal spatial and social-action networks.
role.uz: Ko'ruv harakati (MT+) tahlilini pastki tepa fazoviy va ijtimoiy harakat tarmoqlari bilan bog'laydi.

clinical.en: Lesions impair visual motion integration and spatial attention.
clinical.uz: Zararlanishi ko'ruv harakati integratsiyasi va fazoviy diqqatni buzadi.

sources.title: Glasser et al. 2016, Nature — A multi-modal parcellation of human cerebral cortex

description.en: Dorsal transitional visual area (DVT) on the medial parieto-occipital sulcus bank between POS2/PCV and dorsal V2/V6.
description.uz: Medial tepa-ensa egati devorida POS2/PCV bilan dorsal V2/V6 orasida joylashgan dorsal o'tish ko'ruv maydoni (DVT).

role.en: Relays peripheral visual motion and optic flow from early visual cortex (V2/V6) to medial parietal navigation circuits.
role.uz: Periferik ko'ruv harakati va optik oqimni erta ko'ruv po'stlog'idan (V2/V6) medial tepa navigatsiya zanjirlariga uzatadi.

clinical.en: Medial parieto-occipital lesions impair visually guided locomotion and reaching.
clinical.uz: Medial tepa-ensa zararlanishi ko'ruv nazoratidagi harakatlanish va qo'l uzatishni buzadi.

sources.title: Glasser et al. 2016, Nature — A multi-modal parcellation of human cerebral cortex

description.en: Area PGp on the caudal angular gyrus at the transition between the inferior parietal lobule and lateral occipital cortex.
description.uz: Burchak pushtasining kaudal qismida, pastki tepa bo'lakchasi bilan lateral ensa po'stlog'i o'tish joyida joylashgan PGp maydoni.

role.en: Visuospatial and scene-memory node linking occipital visual areas with the posterior parahippocampal and default-mode networks.
role.uz: Ensa ko'ruv sohalarini orqa parahippokampal va default-mode tarmoqlari bilan bog'lovchi ko'ruv-fazoviy va manzara xotirasi tuguni.

clinical.en: Bilateral or right lesions contribute to topographical disorientation, constructional apraxia and Bálint-spectrum deficits.
clinical.uz: Ikki tomonlama yoki o'ng zararlanishi topografik dezoriyentatsiya va konstruktiv apraksiyaga olib keladi.

sources.title: Glasser et al. 2016, Nature — A multi-modal parcellation of human cerebral cortex

description.en: Area IP2 in the anterior-lateral bank of the horizontal intraparietal sulcus dorsal to PFm and anterior to IP1.
description.uz: Gorizontal tepa ichi egatining oldingi-lateral devorida, PFm ustida va IP1 oldida joylashgan IP2 maydoni.

role.en: Core parietal node for numerical magnitude processing (number sense), mental arithmetic and executive working memory.
role.uz: Son miqdorini idrok etish (son hissi), og'zaki hisoblash va ijrochi ishchi xotiraning asosiy tepa tuguni.

clinical.en: Dominant (left) lesions cause primary acalculia (part of Gerstmann syndrome).
clinical.uz: Dominant (chap) zararlanishi birlamchi akalkuliyani (Gerstmann sindromi qismi) keltirib chiqaradi.

sources.title: Glasser et al. 2016, Nature — A multi-modal parcellation of human cerebral cortex

description.en: Area IP1 in the middle-posterior lateral bank of the intraparietal sulcus between IP2 anteriorly and IP0 posteriorly.
description.uz: Tepa ichi egatining o'rta-orqa lateral devorida oldinda IP2 bilan orqada IP0 orasida joylashgan IP1 maydoni.

role.en: Frontoparietal executive control network node supporting visuospatial working memory, relational reasoning and calculation.
role.uz: Ko'ruv-fazoviy ishchi xotira, mantiqiy mulohaza va hisoblashni ta'minlovchi peshona-tepa ijrochi nazorat tuguni.

clinical.en: Lesions impair visuospatial working memory and numerical reasoning.
clinical.uz: Zararlanishi ko'ruv-fazoviy ishchi xotira va sonli mulohazani buzadi.

sources.title: Glasser et al. 2016, Nature — A multi-modal parcellation of human cerebral cortex

description.en: Area IP0 at the posterior-lateral end of the intraparietal sulcus between IP1/PGp and visual areas V3B/V7.
description.uz: Tepa ichi egatining orqa-lateral uchida IP1/PGp bilan V3B/V7 ko'ruv maydonlari orasida joylashgan IP0 maydoni.

role.en: Bridges early dorsal retinotopic visual representations with frontoparietal cognitive control and spatial working memory.
role.uz: Erta dorsal retinotopik ko'ruv tasvirlarini peshona-tepa kognitiv nazorati va fazoviy ishchi xotira bilan bog'laydi.

clinical.en: Lesions impair visual multi-object tracking and spatial attention.
clinical.uz: Zararlanishi bir necha jismni ko'z bilan kuzatish va fazoviy diqqatni buzadi.

sources.title: Glasser et al. 2016, Nature — A multi-modal parcellation of human cerebral cortex

gl-area-pf-opercular.uz: PF qopqoq maydoni (PFop, pastki chekka usti)

description.en: Area PFop on the anterior-inferior supramarginal gyrus forming the parietal opercular lip above the Sylvian fissure.
description.uz: Oldingi-pastki chekka usti pushtasida, Silviy egati ustidagi tepa qopqog'i qirg'og'ini hosil qiluvchi PFop maydoni.

role.en: Integrates secondary somatosensory feedback (OP1/OP4) with phonological and praxis networks.
role.uz: Ikkilamchi somatosensor qayta aloqani (OP1/OP4) fonologik va praksis tarmoqlari bilan birlashtiradi.

clinical.en: Dominant lesions contribute to conduction aphasia, phonological working-memory loss and oral/limb apraxia.
clinical.uz: Dominant yarim shardagi zararlanishi o'tkazuvchi afaziya va og'iz/qo'l apraksiyasiga hissa qo'shadi.

sources.title: Glasser et al. 2016, Nature — A multi-modal parcellation of human cerebral cortex

description.en: Area PF occupying the main crown of the supramarginal gyrus (Brodmann area 40).
description.uz: Chekka usti pushtasining asosiy cho'qqisini egallagan PF maydoni (Brodmann 40).

role.en: Action organization, tool praxis and phonological storage on the left; ventral attention reorienting and bodily self-awareness on the right.
role.uz: Chapda harakatni tashkil etish, asbob praksisi va fonologik xotira; o'ngda ventral diqqatni qayta yo'naltirish va tana sxemasi.

clinical.en: Left PF lesions cause ideomotor apraxia and phonological/repetition deficits; right PF lesions cause hemispatial neglect.
clinical.uz: Chap PF zararlanishi ideomotor apraksiya va takrorlash nuqsonini, o'ng PF zararlanishi gemispatial e'tiborsizlikni beradi.

sources.title: Glasser et al. 2016, Nature — A multi-modal parcellation of human cerebral cortex

gl-area-pfm-complex.uz: PFm maydoni (orqa chekka usti / burchak o'tish sohasi)

description.en: Area PFm at the transition between the posterior supramarginal gyrus and anterior angular gyrus below IP2.
description.uz: Orqa chekka usti pushtasi bilan oldingi burchak pushtasi o'tish joyida, IP2 ostida joylashgan PFm maydoni.

role.en: Major lateral parietal hub of the frontoparietal executive control network: rule switching, decision making and working memory.
role.uz: Peshona-tepa ijrochi nazorat tarmog'ining yirik lateral tepa markazi: qoidalarni almashtirish, qaror qabul qilish va ishchi xotira.

clinical.en: Right lesions cause severe spatial neglect; left lesions cause executive, calculation and praxis deficits.
clinical.uz: O'ng zararlanishi og'ir fazoviy e'tiborsizlik, chap zararlanishi ijrochi, hisoblash va praksis buzilishini beradi.

sources.title: Glasser et al. 2016, Nature — A multi-modal parcellation of human cerebral cortex

description.en: Area PGi on the ventral-anterior angular gyrus capping the posterior superior temporal sulcus.
description.uz: Burchak pushtasining ventral-oldingi qismida, orqa yuqori chakka egati uchini o'rab turuvchi PGi maydoni.

role.en: Core lateral parietal node of the default-mode and semantic networks: narrative comprehension, episodic memory retrieval and social mentalizing.
role.uz: Default-mode va semantik tarmoqlarning lateral tepa o'zagi: matnni tushunish, epizodik xotirani chaqirish va ijtimoiy mentalizatsiya.

clinical.en: Left lesions cause semantic aphasia, alexia and components of Gerstmann syndrome.
clinical.uz: Chap zararlanishi semantik afaziya, aleksiya va Gerstmann sindromi belgilarini beradi.

sources.title: Glasser et al. 2016, Nature — A multi-modal parcellation of human cerebral cortex

description.en: Area PGs on the dorsal angular gyrus between PGi ventrally and the intraparietal sulcus (IP1/IP0) dorsally.
description.uz: Dorsal burchak pushtasida ventralda PGi bilan dorsalda tepa ichi egati (IP1/IP0) orasida joylashgan PGs maydoni.

role.en: Integrates default-mode episodic memory retrieval with visuospatial attention and number/reading processing.
role.uz: Epizodik xotirani chaqirishni ko'ruv-fazoviy diqqat hamda hisoblash va o'qish bilan birlashtiradi.

clinical.en: Left lesions cause Gerstmann syndrome (acalculia, agraphia, finger agnosia, left–right disorientation); early hypometabolism in Alzheimer disease.
clinical.uz: Chap zararlanishi Gerstmann sindromini beradi; Alzheimer kasalligida metabolizmi erta pasayadi.

sources.title: Glasser et al. 2016, Nature — A multi-modal parcellation of human cerebral cortex

description.en: Area V6A in the dorsal parieto-occipital sulcus immediately dorsal to area V6.
description.uz: Tepa-ensa egatining dorsal qismida V6 maydonining bevosita ustida joylashgan V6A ko'ruv-harakat maydoni.

role.en: Visuomotor reach-and-grasp area encoding target position in spatial coordinates and directing the arm during fast reaching.
role.uz: Tezkor qo'l uzatish va ushlashda nishonning fazoviy o'rnini kodlovchi va qo'lni yo'naltiruvchi vizuomotor maydon.

clinical.en: Lesions of V6A are a primary cause of human optic ataxia (misreaching into peripheral visual fields).
clinical.uz: V6A zararlanishi odamda optik ataksiyaning (periferik ko'rish maydonidagi narsalarga noaniq qo'l uzatishning) asosiy sabablaridan biri.

sources.title: Glasser et al. 2016, Nature — A multi-modal parcellation of human cerebral cortex

description.en: Area VMV1 on the anterior lingual gyrus along the medial bank of the collateral sulcus behind PHA1/PHA2.
description.uz: Oldingi tilsimon pushtada kollateral egatning medial qirg'og'i bo'ylab PHA1/PHA2 ortida joylashgan VMV1 maydoni.

role.en: Far-peripheral upper-visual-field and scene-surface processing feeding the parahippocampal place area.
role.uz: Uzoq periferik yuqori ko'rish maydoni va manzara yuzasini tahlil qilib, parahippokampal joy sohasini ta'minlaydi.

clinical.en: Medial PCA infarcts impair visual scene recognition and peripheral upper-field vision.
clinical.uz: Medial PCA infarkti manzarani ko'rib tanish va periferik yuqori maydon ko'rishini buzadi.

sources.title: Glasser et al. 2016, Nature — A multi-modal parcellation of human cerebral cortex

description.en: Area VMV3 on the anterior lingual/collateral sulcus bank lateral to VMV2 and medial to VVC/V8.
description.uz: Oldingi tilsimon pushta va kollateral egat qirg'og'ida VMV2 dan lateralda hamda VVC/V8 dan medialda joylashgan VMV3 maydoni.

role.en: Integrates colour, texture and spatial layout of visual scenes between ventral V4/V8 and the parahippocampal cortex.
role.uz: Ventral V4/V8 bilan parahippokampal po'stloq orasida ko'ruv manzaralarining rangi, teksturasi va fazoviy tuzilishini birlashtiradi.

clinical.en: Lesions contribute to landmark agnosia and colour/texture deficits.
clinical.uz: Zararlanishi joy va mo'ljal agnoziyasiga hamda rang-tekstura idroki buzilishiga olib keladi.

sources.title: Glasser et al. 2016, Nature — A multi-modal parcellation of human cerebral cortex

description.en: Area PHA2 along the crown and medial bank of the posterior parahippocampal gyrus between PHA1 medially and PHA3 laterally.
description.uz: Orqa parahippokampal pushtada medialda PHA1 bilan lateralda PHA3 orasida joylashgan PHA2 maydoni.

role.en: Central core of the parahippocampal place area (PPA): encodes 3D spatial geometry of rooms, streets and landscapes.
role.uz: Parahippokampal joy sohasining (PPA) markaziy o'zagi: xonalar, ko'chalar va manzaralarning 3D fazoviy geometriyasini kodlaydi.

clinical.en: Lesions cause topographical disorientation and inability to learn new spatial environments.
clinical.uz: Zararlanishi topografik dezoriyentatsiya va yangi joylarni eslab qola olmaslikni beradi.

sources.title: Glasser et al. 2016, Nature — A multi-modal parcellation of human cerebral cortex

description.en: Area V4t (V4 transitional) on the lateral occipital cortex immediately ventral to MT and dorsal to LO3/FST.
description.uz: Lateral ensa po'stlog'ida MT maydonidan bevosita ventralda va LO3/FST dan dorsalda joylashgan V4t o'tish maydoni.

role.en: Bridges form-selective area V4/LO with motion-selective area MT within the human MT+ complex.
role.uz: Odamning MT+ kompleksi ichida shaklga sezgir V4/LO maydonini harakatga sezgir MT maydoni bilan bog'laydi.

clinical.en: Lesions impair perception of moving shapes and biological motion.
clinical.uz: Zararlanishi harakatdagi shakllar va biologik harakatni idrok etishni buzadi.

sources.title: Glasser et al. 2016, Nature — A multi-modal parcellation of human cerebral cortex

gl-area-fst.uz: Yuqori chakka egati tubi harakat maydoni (FST)

description.en: Area FST at the anterior-ventral edge of the MT+ motion complex between MT/MST and PH.
description.uz: MT+ harakat kompleksining oldingi-ventral chekkasida, MT/MST bilan PH maydoni orasida joylashgan FST maydoni.

role.en: Extracts 3D structure-from-motion, articulated biological motion and action kinematics.
role.uz: Harakat orqali 3D tuzilishni, bo'g'imli biologik harakatni va harakat kinematikasini ajratib oladi.

clinical.en: Lesions impair 3D motion perception and recognition of actions from point-light displays.
clinical.uz: Zararlanishi 3D harakat idrokini va harakatlanuvchi shakl orqali harakatni tanishni buzadi.

sources.title: Glasser et al. 2016, Nature — A multi-modal parcellation of human cerebral cortex

description.en: Area V3CD on the lateral occipital cortex between V3A/V3B dorsally and LO1/LO2 ventrally.
description.uz: Lateral ensa po'stlog'ida dorsalda V3A/V3B bilan ventralda LO1/LO2 orasida joylashgan V3CD ko'ruv maydoni.

role.en: Processes kinetic boundaries, central/paracentral contours and 3D shape cues.
role.uz: Kinetik chegaralar, markaziy konturlar va 3D shakl belgilarini qayta ishlaydi.

clinical.en: Lateral occipital lesions cause contour-integration and form-recognition deficits.
clinical.uz: Lateral ensa zararlanishi konturlarni birlashtirish va shaklni tanish buzilishini beradi.

sources.title: Glasser et al. 2016, Nature — A multi-modal parcellation of human cerebral cortex

description.en: Area LO3 on the lateral temporo-occipital cortex between LO1/LO2 posteriorly and MT/V4t anteriorly.
description.uz: Lateral chakka-ensa po'stlog'ida orqada LO1/LO2 bilan oldinda MT/V4t orasida joylashgan LO3 maydoni.

role.en: Integrates static object shape (LO) with motion signals (MT+) for recognizing moving objects and bodies.
role.uz: Harakatdagi narsalar va tana qismlarini tanish uchun statik shakl (LO) va harakat (MT+) signallarini birlashtiradi.

clinical.en: Lesions contribute to visual object and body-form agnosia.
clinical.uz: Zararlanishi narsa va tana shakli ko'ruv agnoziyasiga hissa qo'shadi.

sources.title: Glasser et al. 2016, Nature — A multi-modal parcellation of human cerebral cortex

description.en: Area VMV2 in the collateral sulcus between VMV1 medially and VMV3 laterally.
description.uz: Kollateral egatda medialda VMV1 bilan lateralda VMV3 orasida joylashgan VMV2 ko'ruv maydoni.

role.en: Retinotopic ventromedial scene- and surface-processing area feeding the parahippocampal place area.
role.uz: Parahippokampal joy sohasini ma'lumot bilan ta'minlovchi retinotopik ventromedial manzara va yuza tahlili maydoni.

clinical.en: PCA infarcts here impair visual scene layout recognition.
clinical.uz: Bu yerdagi PCA infarkti manzara tuzilishini ko'rib tanishni buzadi.

sources.title: Glasser et al. 2016, Nature — A multi-modal parcellation of human cerebral cortex

description.en: Area 31pd on the dorsal-posterior cingulate gyrus and lower bank of the subparietal sulcus above 31pv and d23ab.
description.uz: Dorsal-orqa belbog' pushtasi va tepa osti egatining pastki qirg'og'ida, 31pv va d23ab ustida joylashgan 31pd maydoni.

role.en: Default-mode network hub integrating autobiographical memory with medial parietal spatial attention.
role.uz: Avtobiografik xotirani medial tepa fazoviy diqqati bilan birlashtiruvchi default-mode tarmog'i markazi.

clinical.en: Shows early hypometabolism in Alzheimer disease.
clinical.uz: Alzheimer kasalligida erta gipometabolizm namoyon qiladi.

sources.title: Glasser et al. 2016, Nature — A multi-modal parcellation of human cerebral cortex

description.en: Area 31a on the anterior dorsal posterior cingulate gyrus between 23d ventrally and the subparietal sulcus dorsally.
description.uz: Oldingi-dorsal orqa belbog' pushtasida ventralda 23d bilan dorsalda tepa osti egati orasida joylashgan 31a maydoni.

role.en: Default-mode node linking posterior cingulate memory circuits with midcingulate and prefrontal cortex.
role.uz: Orqa belbog' xotira zanjirlarini o'rta belbog' va prefrontal po'stloq bilan bog'lovchi default-mode tuguni.

clinical.en: Early amyloid accumulation and metabolic decline in Alzheimer disease.
clinical.uz: Alzheimer kasalligida erta amiloid to'planishi va metabolizm pasayishi kuzatiladi.

sources.title: Glasser et al. 2016, Nature — A multi-modal parcellation of human cerebral cortex

description.en: Ventral visual complex (VVC) on the mid-fusiform and collateral sulcus cortex anterior to V8 and medial to the fusiform face complex.
description.uz: O'rta duksimon pushta va kollateral egatda V8 dan oldinda hamda duksimon yuz kompleksidan medialda joylashgan ventral ko'ruv kompleksi (VVC).

role.en: Processes colour, surface material properties and non-face object categories along the ventral visual stream.
role.uz: Ventral ko'ruv oqimi bo'ylab rang, yuza materiali xossalari va narsalar toifalarini qayta ishlaydi.

clinical.en: Lesions cause colour agnosia/achromatopsia and visual object agnosia.
clinical.uz: Zararlanishi rang agnoziyasi/axromatopsiya va ko'ruv narsa agnoziyasini beradi.

sources.title: Glasser et al. 2016, Nature — A multi-modal parcellation of human cerebral cortex

description.en: Brodmann area 25 (subgenual/subcallosal cingulate) beneath the rostrum and genu of the corpus callosum in front of the lamina terminalis.
description.uz: Qadoqsimon tana tumshug'i va tizzasi ostida, lamina terminalis oldida joylashgan Brodmann 25-maydoni (subgenual belbog').

role.en: Primary visceromotor cortical driver of autonomic, neuroendocrine (HPA axis) and negative-mood responses via projections to the amygdala, hypothalamus and PAG.
role.uz: Amigdala, gipotalamus va PAG ga proyeksiyalar orqali vegetativ, neyroendokrin va salbiy kayfiyat javoblarini boshqaruvchi visseromotor markaz.

clinical.en: Hyperactive in major depressive disorder; surgical target of subcallosal cingulate DBS for treatment-resistant depression.
clinical.uz: Og'ir depressiyada giperfaol; davolashga chidamli depressiyada subkallozal DBS neyroxirurgik nishoni.

sources.title: Glasser et al. 2016, Nature — A multi-modal parcellation of human cerebral cortex

description.en: Area s32 on the ventromedial prefrontal surface immediately anterior to subgenual area 25 and ventral to a24/p32.
description.uz: Ventromedial prefrontal yuzada subgenual 25-maydonning bevosita oldida va a24/p32 ostida joylashgan s32 maydoni.

role.en: Couples default-mode self-referential valuation with subgenual visceromotor and emotional regulation.
role.uz: O'zi haqida fikrlash va baholashni (default-mode) tizza osti visseromotor hamda emotsional boshqaruvi bilan bog'laydi.

clinical.en: Key node of the affective network altered in major depression and targeted via DLPFC-to-subgenual rTMS connectivity.
clinical.uz: Og'ir depressiyada o'zgaradigan va DLPFC rTMS aloqalari orqali nishonga olinadigan affektiv tarmoq tuguni.

sources.title: Glasser et al. 2016, Nature — A multi-modal parcellation of human cerebral cortex

description.en: Area pOFC at the caudal medial edge of the orbitofrontal cortex immediately anterior to the anterior perforated substance and ventral striatum.
description.uz: Orbitofrontal po'stloqning eng orqa-medial chekkasida, oldingi ilma-teshik modda va ventral striatum oldida joylashgan pOFC maydoni.

role.en: Limbic periallocortical orbitofrontal zone integrating olfactory, visceral and amygdala inputs to regulate autonomic arousal and emotion.
role.uz: Vegetativ qo'zg'alish va emotsiyani boshqarish uchun hid, visseral hamda amigdala kirishlarini birlashtiruvchi limbik orbitofrontal zona.

clinical.en: Involved in frontotemporal dementia, autonomic emotion dysregulation and post-aneurysmal frontal syndromes.
clinical.uz: Peshona-chakka demensiyasi, emotsional-vegetativ disregulyatsiya va anevrizmadan keyingi frontal sindromlarda ishtirok etadi.

sources.title: Glasser et al. 2016, Nature — A multi-modal parcellation of human cerebral cortex

description.en: Area PoI1 on the ventral-posterior long gyrus of the insula along the inferior circular sulcus.
description.uz: Orolchaning ventral-orqa uzun pushtasida, pastki halqasimon egat bo'ylab joylashgan PoI1 maydoni.

role.en: Granular viscerosensory and nociceptive cortex receiving spinothalamic and vagal interoceptive projections.
role.uz: Spinotalamik va adashgan nerv (vagal) interotseptiv proyeksiyalarini qabul qiluvchi granulyar visserosensor va og'riq po'stlog'i.

clinical.en: Lesions alter pain/temperature perception and cardiovascular autonomic tone.
clinical.uz: Zararlanishi og'riq va harorat idrokini hamda yurak-qon tomir vegetativ tonusini o'zgartiradi.

sources.title: Glasser et al. 2016, Nature — A multi-modal parcellation of human cerebral cortex

description.en: Insular granular complex (Ig) at the dorsal-posterior corner of the insula adjacent to retroinsular cortex (RI) and OP2-3.
description.uz: Orolchaning dorsal-orqa burchagida, retroinsulyar po'stloq (RI) va OP2-3 yonida joylashgan orolcha granulyar kompleksi (Ig).

role.en: Primary interoceptive, thermosensory (cooling/warming), nociceptive and vestibular representation of the body.
role.uz: Tananing birlamchi interotseptiv, harorat (sovuq/issiq), og'riq va vestibulyar vakilligi.

clinical.en: Strokes here cause contralateral thermosensory/pain deficits, central post-stroke pain or vestibular imbalance.
clinical.uz: Bu yerdagi insult qarama-qarshi harorat/og'riq sezgisi buzilishini, markaziy og'riq yoki vestibulyar muvozanat yo'qolishini beradi.

sources.title: Glasser et al. 2016, Nature — A multi-modal parcellation of human cerebral cortex

description.en: Area FOP5 on the anterior inner surface of the frontal operculum deep to pars triangularis (area 45) and dorsal to AVI.
description.uz: Peshona qopqog'ining oldingi ichki yuzasida, pars triangularis (45-maydon) ostida va AVI ustida joylashgan FOP5 maydoni.

role.en: Links Broca’s language network (area 44/45) with the cingulo-opercular salience and cognitive-control network.
role.uz: Broka til tarmog'ini (44/45-maydonlar) belbog'-qopqoq salience va kognitiv nazorat tarmog'i bilan bog'laydi.

clinical.en: Dominant lesions contribute to expressive language initiation and articulatory control deficits.
clinical.uz: Dominant zararlanishi ekspressiv nutqni boshlash va artikulyator nazorat buzilishiga hissa qo'shadi.

sources.title: Glasser et al. 2016, Nature — A multi-modal parcellation of human cerebral cortex

description.en: Area p10p on the lateral frontopolar boundary posterior to a10p/10pp and anterior to area 46/a9-46v.
description.uz: Lateral peshona qutbi chegarasida a10p/10pp dan orqada va 46/a9-46v maydonlaridan oldinda joylashgan p10p maydoni.

role.en: Transition hub between frontopolar metacognitive branching and dorsolateral prefrontal working memory.
role.uz: Peshona qutbi metakognitiv tarmoqlanishi bilan dorsolateral prefrontal ishchi xotira orasidagi o'tish markazi.

clinical.en: Lesions impair multi-step task management and cognitive flexibility.
clinical.uz: Zararlanishi ko'p bosqichli vazifalarni boshqarish va kognitiv moslashuvchanlikni buzadi.

sources.title: Glasser et al. 2016, Nature — A multi-modal parcellation of human cerebral cortex

description.en: Area p47r in the anterior inferior frontal sulcus/gyrus transition between a47r anteriorly and 45/IFSa posteriorly.
description.uz: Oldingi pastki peshona egati va pushtasi o'tish joyida, oldinda a47r bilan orqada 45/IFSa orasida joylashgan p47r maydoni.

role.en: Ventrolateral prefrontal control node for controlled memory retrieval and resolution of competition among semantic alternatives.
role.uz: Xotiradan boshqariladigan eslash va semantik muqobillar orasidagi raqobatni hal qilish uchun ventrolateral prefrontal tugun.

clinical.en: Lesions impair verbal fluency and executive retrieval.
clinical.uz: Zararlanishi nutq ravonligi va xotiradan ijrochi chaqirishni buzadi.

sources.title: Glasser et al. 2016, Nature — A multi-modal parcellation of human cerebral cortex

description.en: Area TGv forming the ventral and basal aspect of the temporal pole anterior to TE2a and PeEc.
description.uz: Chakka qutbining TE2a va PeEc dan oldindagi ventral hamda pastki yuzasini hosil qiluvchi TGv maydoni (Brodmann 38).

role.en: Ventral transmodal semantic hub linking visual object/face representations with socio-emotional and conceptual memory via the uncinate fasciculus.
role.uz: Ilmoqsimon tutam orqali ko'ruv narsa/yuz tasvirlarini ijtimoiy-emotsional va tushunchaviy xotira bilan bog'lovchi ventral semantik markaz.

clinical.en: Severely atrophic early in semantic dementia (svPPA), causing multimodal loss of object and person knowledge.
clinical.uz: Semantik demensiyada (svPPA) erta va kuchli atrofiyalanib, narsalar hamda shaxslar haqidagi bilimning yo'qolishiga olib keladi.

sources.title: Glasser et al. 2016, Nature — A multi-modal parcellation of human cerebral cortex

description.en: Medial auditory belt (MBelt) along the anteromedial border of Heschl’s gyrus inside the Sylvian fissure medial to A1.
description.uz: Silviy egati ichida Geshl pushtasining oldingi-medial qirrasi bo'ylab A1 dan medialda joylashgan medial eshituv kamari (MBelt).

role.en: Second-stage auditory cortex receiving direct input from A1 to process pitch, vocalizations and temporal sound envelopes.
role.uz: A1 dan bevosita kirish qabul qilib, ohang, ovoz va tovushning vaqt xususiyatlarini qayta ishlovchi ikkinchi bosqich eshituv po'stlog'i.

clinical.en: Bilateral belt lesions contribute to auditory agnosia and amusia.
clinical.uz: Ikki tomonlama zararlanishi eshituv agnoziyasi va amuziyaga hissa qo'shadi.

sources.title: Glasser et al. 2016, Nature — A multi-modal parcellation of human cerebral cortex

description.en: Lateral auditory belt (LBelt) along the posterolateral border of Heschl’s gyrus immediately behind A1 and medial to PBelt.
description.uz: Geshl pushtasining orqa-lateral qirrasi bo'ylab A1 ning bevosita ortida va PBelt dan medialda joylashgan lateral eshituv kamari (LBelt).

role.en: Second-stage auditory cortex integrating bandwidth and frequency sweeps for speech-phoneme and spatial sound processing.
role.uz: Nutq fonemalari va tovushning fazoviy joylashuvini qayta ishlash uchun chastota o'zgarishlarini birlashtiruvchi ikkinchi bosqich eshituv po'stlog'i.

clinical.en: Left lesions impair early phonological decoding of speech sounds.
clinical.uz: Chap tomonlama zararlanishi nutq tovushlarini erta fonologik dekodlashni buzadi.

sources.title: Glasser et al. 2016, Nature — A multi-modal parcellation of human cerebral cortex

description.en: Area A4 on the lateral aspect of the superior temporal gyrus and planum temporale immediately ventral/lateral to PBelt.
description.uz: Yuqori chakka pushtasining lateral qirrasi va planum temporale'da PBelt dan bevosita tashqarida joylashgan A4 eshituv kompleksi.

role.en: Higher auditory association cortex analyzing complex spectrotemporal patterns of speech, voices and music.
role.uz: Nutq, ovoz va musiqaning murakkab spektrotemporal andozalarini tahlil qiluvchi yuqori darajali eshituv assotsiativ po'stlog'i.

clinical.en: Dominant lesions cause Wernicke-spectrum speech comprehension and phonological deficits.
clinical.uz: Dominant yarim shardagi zararlanishi Vernike turidagi nutqni tushunish va fonologik buzilishlarni beradi.

sources.title: Glasser et al. 2016, Nature — A multi-modal parcellation of human cerebral cortex

description.en: Area STSva on the anterior-ventral bank of the superior temporal sulcus between STSda dorsally and TE1a ventrally.
description.uz: Yuqori chakka egatining oldingi-ventral qirg'og'ida dorsalda STSda bilan ventralda TE1a orasida joylashgan STSva maydoni.

role.en: Anterior temporal language, semantic and social-cognition node integrating spoken words into sentence meaning.
role.uz: Og'zaki so'zlarni gap mazmuniga birlashtiruvchi oldingi chakka til, semantik va ijtimoiy kognitsiya tuguni.

clinical.en: Affected in semantic dementia and anterior temporal strokes, impairing sentence and lexical comprehension.
clinical.uz: Semantik demensiya va oldingi chakka insultlarida zararlanib, leksik va gap tushunishni buzadi.

sources.title: Glasser et al. 2016, Nature — A multi-modal parcellation of human cerebral cortex

description.en: Area TE1m on the mid-lateral crown of the middle temporal gyrus between TE1a anteriorly and TE1p posteriorly.
description.uz: O'rta chakka pushtasining o'rta cho'qqisida oldinda TE1a bilan orqada TE1p orasida joylashgan TE1m maydoni.

role.en: Lateral temporal node of the default-mode and semantic networks supporting conceptual retrieval and autobiographical memory.
role.uz: Tushunchalarni eslash va avtobiografik xotirani ta'minlovchi default-mode hamda semantik tarmoqlarning lateral chakka tuguni.

clinical.en: Dominant lesions cause anomia and semantic memory deficits.
clinical.uz: Dominant yarim shardagi zararlanishi anomiya va semantik xotira nuqsonini beradi.

sources.title: Glasser et al. 2016, Nature — A multi-modal parcellation of human cerebral cortex

description.en: Para-insular area (PI) in the anterior inferior circular sulcus of the insula at the junction of the temporal pole/planum polare and ventral insula.
description.uz: Orolchaning oldingi-pastki halqasimon egatida, chakka qutbi/planum polare bilan ventral orolcha tutashuvida joylashgan parainsulyar maydon (PI).

role.en: Integrates auditory-vocal signals from the anterior temporal plane with visceromotor and autonomic circuits of the ventral insula.
role.uz: Oldingi chakka tekisligidan keluvchi eshituv-ovoz signallarini ventral orolchaning visseromotor va vegetativ zanjirlari bilan birlashtiradi.

clinical.en: Involved in temporal-insular seizure spread producing autonomic and viscerosensory auras.
clinical.uz: Chakka-orolcha tutqanoqlari tarqalishida ishtirok etib, vegetativ va visserosensor auralarni chaqiradi.

sources.title: Glasser et al. 2016, Nature — A multi-modal parcellation of human cerebral cortex

description.en: Area a32 prime on the dorsal bank of the anterior/midcingulate sulcus anterior to p32' and ventral to 8BM.
description.uz: Oldingi-o'rta belbog' egatining dorsal qirg'og'ida, p32' dan oldinda va 8BM ostida joylashgan a32' maydoni.

role.en: Cingulo-opercular and executive control node evaluating cognitive effort, decision conflict and error feedback.
role.uz: Kognitiv zo'riqish, qaror ziddiyati va xato haqidagi qayta aloqani baholovchi belbog'-qopqoq hamda ijrochi nazorat tuguni.

clinical.en: Lesions cause executive apathy, reduced cognitive effort and impaired conflict monitoring.
clinical.uz: Zararlanishi ijrochi apatiya, kognitiv tashabbus pasayishi va ziddiyat monitoringi buzilishini beradi.

sources.title: Glasser et al. 2016, Nature — A multi-modal parcellation of human cerebral cortex
